description: Curated Kaze no Notam function-purpose map. Add an entry only with decompiled or live-trace evidence; keep names snake_case with a kaze_ prefix. Categories: core, flight, collision, objective, menu, map_screen, cd_stream, render, hud, sound, library, unknown.

functions.name: kaze_main_game_loop
functions.purpose: Main game loop. Allocates the 0xed430-byte live-root state block via kaze_heap_alloc into kaze_state_base_ptr, resets input latches, runs the double-buffered render loop (page index +0x98, primitive cursor +0x9c, load metric +0xa0, vsync divisor +0xa4), and frees the root on exit. +0x0 is the loop-exit/next-mode code, +0x4 the frame-loop running flag.

functions.name: kaze_heap_alloc
functions.purpose: Heap allocator used for the live-root block (called with element count 1 and size 0xed430 by the main loop).

functions.name: kaze_map_cdlfile_lookup
functions.purpose: Resolves CdlFILE metadata for \BAL\MAP\MAPDATA.DAT, TEXDATA.DAT, and RMODE.DAT into live-root +0x48224/+0x4823c/+0x48254.

functions.name: kaze_drawenv_init
functions.purpose: Initializes primary and secondary DRAWENV/DISPENV blocks (+0xbe..+0xc0, +0x24136..+0x24138, draw/disp bases +0xa8/+0x104/+0x24120/+0x2417c).

functions.name: kaze_stage_staging_copy
functions.purpose: Copies the menu staging block kaze_staged_stage_index..kaze_staged_stage_variant into the live stage block kaze_stage_index..kaze_stage_variant during flight/map initialization.

functions.name: kaze_stage_map_cd_loader
functions.purpose: Per-stage CD map loader: MAPDATA.DAT one 0x91000-byte block at +stage_index*0x122 sectors, TEXDATA.DAT twelve 0x20-sector chunks at stage_index*0xd80+(stage_level-1)*0x480+stage_mode*0x180, RMODE.DAT two 0x16-sector chunks at (stage_variant-1)*0x2c; rebuilds the +0xecb28 terrain/model pointer table from the +0x6b6e0 MAPDATA header.

functions.name: kaze_cd_read_sectors
functions.purpose: Blocking CD sector read into a destination buffer (retried until non-negative), used by the stage map loader with the +0x5b6e0 staging buffer.

functions.name: kaze_cd_read_postprocess
functions.purpose: Post-read processing/upload step invoked after each staged CD chunk read by kaze_stage_map_cd_loader.

functions.name: kaze_flight_state_init
functions.purpose: Flight/stage state initializer: wind layers at 0xb16a8, mode-0 marker segment at base+0x58a74 when stage variant is 1, stage-flag visual effect blocks, and the post-event sound latch.

functions.name: kaze_mode1_slot_populate
functions.purpose: Populates mode-1 objective slots at base+0x58e14/+0x58e18/+0x58e1c from the static target table at 0x8008c6a4 when the live stage mode is 1.

functions.name: kaze_dynamic_object_spawner
functions.purpose: Per-stage dynamic-object spawner: zeroes all 18 slots of the +0x5901c table, then spawns records from the per-stage placement tables kaze_dynobj_placement_table_0/kaze_dynobj_placement_table_1/kaze_dynobj_placement_table_2 (0x40-byte records; types 3/10/6 derive orientation from node pairs in kaze_route_node_next_table) via kaze_dynamic_object_spawn_slot.

functions.name: kaze_dynamic_object_spawn_slot
functions.purpose: Fills one +0x5901c dynamic-object slot (stride 0x78): type, position, rotation, unit scale, model id (+0x42, negative = remap), brightness 0x80, spin terms, second node position, movement params, extras.

functions.name: kaze_min_gas_init
functions.purpose: Initializes kaze_min_gas from kaze_min_gas_base_table[stage index], selecting one of that entry's four fields based on kaze_stage_flags (0/1/3/5), shifted left 12.

functions.name: kaze_wind_motion_update
functions.purpose: Per-frame wind/motion update: selects the active wind layer, blends transitions (wind transition latch +0x20), and updates motion angle/speed fields at 0xb173c..0xb1760.

functions.name: kaze_object_physics_snapshot
functions.purpose: Consumes per-frame deltas (0xb16e8..0xb16f0) and maintains previous-position/route-offset snapshots at live-root +0x78..+0x90.

functions.name: kaze_vertical_control_update
functions.purpose: Vertical control/burner path updating vertical control, vertical wind, landing lockout, and vertical penalty fields at 0xb1764..0xb1770.

functions.name: kaze_gas_floor_reset
functions.purpose: Resets kaze_gas_floor (kaze_gas_floor) to kaze_min_gas (kaze_min_gas).

functions.name: kaze_target_gas_law
functions.purpose: Burner control law: kaze_target_gas = kaze_min_gas + kaze_terrain_height_layer * 0x76c0 + 0x28000; also compares gas floor against min gas with -0xf000/-0xeff1 thresholds.

functions.name: kaze_failure_terminal_handler
functions.purpose: Failure handler: sets kaze_state_flags bit 0x00800000 and the post-event sound latch before result audio.

functions.name: kaze_success_terminal_handler
functions.purpose: Full-route success handler: sets kaze_state_flags bit 0x00400000 and the post-event sound latch before result audio.

functions.name: kaze_pause_exit_prompt
functions.purpose: Pause/exit prompt branch; sets the exit prompt latch at base+0xecafc.

functions.name: kaze_terrain_zone_collision_query
functions.purpose: Terrain/zone collision query: converts tile grid coords to world (*0xed8+0x76c), resolves remapped zone ids through +0xe1e60 using the +0xecaf8 page, tests +0xe36e0 shapes via kaze_collision_shape_test with the +0x5ae8c fallback; returns 1 = shape hit (direction mask) or 2 = below terrain (mask 4).

functions.name: kaze_collision_shape_test
functions.purpose: Tests one 12-byte collision shape record: negative X half-extent selects a sphere distance test, otherwise a yaw-rotated box with per-axis penetration in GTE scratchpad; result mask encodes hit direction.

functions.name: kaze_dynamic_object_collision_query
functions.purpose: Dynamic-object collision query over the 18-slot +0x5901c table: coarse 0x2c89 axis cull, rotates the delta into object space, then tests the object's +0xe36e0 shape run via kaze_object_shape_test.

functions.name: kaze_object_shape_test
functions.purpose: Per-shape test used by the dynamic-object collision query (object-space variant of kaze_collision_shape_test).

functions.name: kaze_environment_color_update
functions.purpose: Environment/sky color source: writes the environment color sets (+0x4828e..+0x4829e), effect intensity (+0x4827c), light matrix terms (+0x481b8..), and byte-splices the base RGB triple at +0x48288..+0x4828c from the +0x482ac/+0x482b0 lookup.

functions.name: kaze_environment_poly_refresh
functions.purpose: Per-frame refresh of the environment POLY_G4 blocks (+0x482f4/+0x48354/+0x48504) from the environment color sets via GTE scratchpad pointers.

functions.name: kaze_hud_gauge_renderer
functions.purpose: In-flight HUD renderer: gas/target/min/floor gauge bars (POLY_F4 slots at +0x48c44/+0x48c74/+0x48c8c/+0x48ca4), wind compass cardinals (+0x48a94), heading needle (+0x48bc4..), 5-slot wind-layer arrow panel (+0x489f0, current layer bright; layer = -pos_y/0x76c - 3), and altitude marker (+0x48b34).

functions.name: kaze_post_event_menu_update
functions.purpose: Post-result/exit UI state machine consuming the post-event menu state at base+0x48e0c.

functions.name: kaze_render_vector_load
functions.purpose: Loads the route/view render SVECTOR at +0x509e0 into the GTE.

functions.name: kaze_marker_brightness_anim
functions.purpose: Advances the marker/effect brightness phase at +0x4974c.

functions.name: kaze_landing_event_update
functions.purpose: Flight/landing event path touching wind/vertical fields and dynamic-object extra state (+0x59088).

functions.name: kaze_draw_area_anim
functions.purpose: Animates the draw-area RECT at +0x48204..+0x4820a.

functions.name: kaze_post_event_sprite_anim
functions.purpose: Advances the post-event sprite animation counter at +0x4a190.

functions.name: kaze_post_event_sprite_init
functions.purpose: Initializes slot 0 post-event sprite CLUT/TPage (+0x4a1a2/+0x4a1aa) and overlay primitive fields (+0x4a288..).

functions.name: kaze_post_event_menu_prim_init
functions.purpose: Post-event menu/confirmation/dialog SPRT, panel POLY_F4, icon/tile SPRT_8, and marker primitive setup (+0x49194..+0x49724).

functions.name: kaze_post_event_frame_prim_init
functions.purpose: Post-event SPRT_16/SPRT/POLY_FT4/SPRT_8/POLY_F4 frame and footer primitive setup (+0x489ec..+0x48d84), including the HUD gauge POLY_F4 slots later driven by the HUD renderer.

functions.name: kaze_environment_lookup_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the environment color lookup value at +0x482b0 consumed by kaze_environment_color_update.

functions.name: kaze_post_event_split_prim_init
functions.purpose: Split post-event POLY_FT4/POLY_F4/DR_TPAGE setup (+0x487c4..+0x488c4).

functions.name: kaze_post_event_grid_prim_init
functions.purpose: Post-event grid POLY_FT4 slots, grid panel POLY_F4, and LINE_F2/LINE_F3 setup (+0x49804..+0x49b6e).

functions.name: kaze_post_event_banner_prim_init
functions.purpose: Post-event banner/score SPRT and draw TPage setup (+0x49ea0..+0x4a180) plus large-panel/copy tables.

functions.name: kaze_start_location_map_loop
functions.purpose: Start-location map screen loop: runs while kaze_map_state != 9, recomputes kaze_map_location_valid each state-2 frame via kaze_start_location_validity(terrain tiles, zone table), commits the start via kaze_start_location_commit on exit; skipped when kaze_staged_stage_variant is nonzero (kaze_start_location_skip_path path). Work buffers at bytes +0x4120/+0x28198.

functions.name: kaze_start_location_validity
functions.purpose: Start-location validity rule: cursor in 0x14..0xeb both axes; in mode-1 staging (kaze_menu_mode_source==0) at least 0x20 half-cells from the per-stage target (kaze_start_location_target_x_table/kaze_start_location_target_z_table indexed by kaze_menu_stage_source); terrain tile must lack flags 0x0c000000, zone id not in per-stage exclusion lists (kaze_start_zone_excl_table_mode1/kaze_start_zone_excl_table_mode0/kaze_start_zone_excl_table_mode2), zero +0xe2ee0 zone entry, terrain type nibble < 3.

functions.name: kaze_start_location_commit
functions.purpose: Commits the selected start location into staged/live start coordinates when the map screen exits at state 9.

functions.name: kaze_settings_menu_dispatch
functions.purpose: Settings menu row dispatcher; row 2 adjusts the mode source kaze_menu_mode_source via kaze_settings_mode_row_handler (source 0 stages mode 1, 1 stages mode 0, 2 stages mode 2).

functions.name: kaze_settings_mode_row_handler
functions.purpose: Row-2 handler adjusting the mode source value kaze_menu_mode_source.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_exit_handler
functions.purpose: Nested task-letter carousel handler around nested state 0x2b; current natural-route blocker for reaching settings rows without RAM writes.

functions.name: kaze_start_location_skip_path
functions.purpose: Alternate start path taken when kaze_staged_stage_variant is nonzero, bypassing the interactive map screen.

functions.name: kaze_map_screen_state_renderers
functions.purpose: First of the map-screen state renderers; kaze_map_screen_state_renderers/kaze_start_map_cursor_move/kaze_map_cursor_confirm_input/kaze_map_panel_scroll_update/kaze_map_second_confirm_input/kaze_map_fade_in_state/kaze_map_cursor_state_draw/kaze_map_confirm_state_draw/kaze_map_fade_out_state render the map screen states (cursor, confirmation, fade) inside the map loop; kaze_map_screen_free_buffers finalizes and kaze_input_edge_detect/kaze_gs_set_work_base handle input/packet areas.

functions.name: kaze_input_poll
functions.purpose: Controller input poll; source of the button mask constants (Triangle 0x10, Circle 0x20, Cross 0x40, Square 0x80, Start 0x800, Up 0x1000, Right 0x2000, Down 0x4000, Left 0x8000).

functions.name: kaze_score_banner_renderer
functions.purpose: Post-event results/score banner renderer: positions icon/label/digit SPRTs (+0x49ea0..+0x49fc6) from root +0x8/+0x10 and stage fields, delegates confirm box to kaze_confirm_box_renderer and radar to kaze_minimap_radar_builder.

functions.name: kaze_banner_simple_renderer
functions.purpose: Trimmed banner renderer drawing a single SPRT (+0x49ec8) with x0 0x20 and y0 from root +0x8, plus optional confirm box and background TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_minimap_radar_builder
functions.purpose: Builds the on-screen radar/minimap: maps player position/heading and the +0x58a74/+0x58e14 object arrays into dot/needle/frame vertices (+0x494b4/+0x496d4/+0x496f4/+0x4972c).

functions.name: kaze_postevent_menu_anim
functions.purpose: Post-event menu update/draw gated by state flag 0x40000000 and the +0x48e0c phase counter; animates confirmation brightness ramps and positions the confirm SPRT group from +0x48e18 anchors.

functions.name: kaze_confirm_box_renderer
functions.purpose: Draws the confirm/dialog box at a caller position: confirmation SPRT group (+0x49204..+0x49248), background POLY strips, and the +0x48e1c TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_minimap_marker_renderer
functions.purpose: Minimap object-marker renderer: polar-projects each +0x58e14 object around the balloon into SPRT_8 markers (+0x49c10..), draws frame lines, panel, draw-areas, TPages, and label SPRTs.

functions.name: kaze_mode_object_update
functions.purpose: Per-frame update of the +0x58e0c mode-object slots: trig velocity, gravity, terrain/target collision via the collision queries, per-slot cull flags; in sub-mode 1 also rotates the +0xecb00 animation ring into a graph buffer.

functions.name: kaze_postevent_prim_dispatch
functions.purpose: Post-event primitive dispatcher gated by +0x14 flags; AddPrims the post-event SPRT/POLY groups and delegates to the minimap renderer when the live stage mode is 2.

functions.name: kaze_postevent_bg_draw
functions.purpose: Post-event background pass gated by the +0x48e0c phase counter; AddPrims background POLY strips and the +0x48e1c TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_env_sky_render_pass
functions.purpose: Above-horizon sky render pass gated by state flag 0x20000000: sky gradient POLY_G4 layers (+0x48354) with per-layer draw flags, DR_TPAGEs (+0x486b4), horizon fill, route/start sprite ribbon culling, and particles.

functions.name: kaze_env_water_render_pass
functions.purpose: Below-horizon water/reflection pass gated by state flag 0x10000000: animated reflected surface from terrain CLUT/TPage lookups, reflected sky POLY_G4 block (+0x48504), and water horizon fill.

functions.name: kaze_screen_composite_draw
functions.purpose: Appends the two full-screen POLY_FT4 overlay halves (+0x487c4/+0x487ec) and a black fill POLY_F4 for screen composite/transitions.

functions.name: kaze_env_prim_init
functions.purpose: One-time environment primitive initializer: sky/water POLY_G4 blocks, horizon quads, DR_TPAGE arrays, buffer-1 clones, route/start marker SPRTs, and packed-terrain CLUT/TPage lookups.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_update
functions.purpose: Per-frame update over the 18-slot +0x5901c dynamic-object table: dispatches type handlers, then writes distance-based render code (+0x8), in-range flag (+0xc), and brightness (+0x44).

functions.name: kaze_marker_slot_update
functions.purpose: State machine for the 10 mode-0 marker slots (+0x58a74): moves markers, tests terrain collision, attaches to dynamic objects, and computes on-screen visibility (+0x4).

functions.name: kaze_balloon_render
functions.purpose: Balloon body renderer: builds rotation/scale/light matrices and draws model slots +0x589e8/+0x589ec with submodel vertex groups +0x58a14/+0x58a24.

functions.name: kaze_mode_object_render
functions.purpose: Renders the six +0x58e0c mode-object slots and projects the balloon LINE_F2 endpoints (+0x489ac/+0x489b0) from submodel pointer groups.

functions.name: kaze_marker_render
functions.purpose: Renders the 10 mode-0 marker slots with per-marker matrices and colors using model asset slot 2 (+0x589f0).

functions.name: kaze_stage_flag_fx_render
functions.purpose: Stage-flag/weather effect renderer: two effect groups gated by the +0xed34c/+0xed378 counters using transforms at +0xed328..+0xed360 and model slots 8-10.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_render
functions.purpose: Renders active +0x5901c dynamic objects, resolving model pointers from the +0xecb28 table (one-based +0xecb24 alias form for remapped negative ids).

functions.name: kaze_terrain_tile_render
functions.purpose: Terrain/map tile renderer: iterates an 8x8 tile grid, resolves tile models from the +0xecb28 table, draws with the +0x509dc GPU code.

functions.name: kaze_asset_prim_master_init
functions.purpose: Master asset/primitive initializer: rebases BALMODEL submodel pointers into +0x589e8.. slots from the +0x509ec offset array, assigns TPage/CLUTs, builds balloon LINE_F2/POLY_FT4 overlays, seeds the +0xecb00 animation ring and stage-flag transforms.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_overlay_builder
functions.purpose: Per-frame balloon/wind overlay quad builder: computes corners from camera yaw (+0x4a) and burner state, projects them via kaze_gte_project_vertex into the +0x488d4 POLY_FT4, and AddPrims it.

functions.name: kaze_gte_project_vertex
functions.purpose: GTE helper: loads one SVECTOR, runs rotate/translate/perspective, stores packed screen XY into the caller's primitive slot, returns depth.

functions.name: kaze_demo_input_playback
functions.purpose: Scripted/demo input playback gated by state flag 0x00100000: feeds {command,timer} entries at +0xed388 (cursor +0xed42c) into the input mask, ramps the +0xed428 fade, and requests exit via root +0x8/+0x4/+0x0; also rebuilds the camera rotation matrix each frame.

functions.name: kaze_landing_goal_handler
functions.purpose: Landing/goal handler: plays landing audio and either raises terminal state flags (+0x14 |= 0x9000) or triggers the landing effect with the struck object's landing parameter.

functions.name: kaze_stage_flag_cloth_anim
functions.purpose: Flag/cloth vertex animator: perturbs model slot 8 vertices with rsin driven by the +0xed348 phase counter.

functions.name: kaze_object_vertex_anim
functions.purpose: Per-object procedural vertex animation using a phase counter in the object struct (+0xec) to index and write animated vertices.

functions.name: kaze_system_boot_init
functions.purpose: Boot init: ResetGraph/ResetCallback, CdInit, DecDCTReset, InitPAD (buffers kaze_pad1_buffer/kaze_pad2_status_byte), _bu_init/_card_auto, then clears VRAM and builds the CD file cache from kaze_cd_root_dir_name.

functions.name: kaze_input_light_defaults_init
functions.purpose: Resets input masks (kaze_input_current_a/98, kaze_input_current_b/14), zeroes the 0x28-byte wind block at kaze_wind_layer0_dir, and seeds default lighting/scalar fields from kaze_camera_anchor_target_x through an unnamed camera-anchor field further in the same block (200, 0x708, 0x10s, -0x32, 4s).

functions.name: kaze_game_state_defaults_init
functions.purpose: Full game-state reset: zeroes live stage block kaze_stage_index.., balloon pos kaze_pos_x/dc/e0=(0x3b600,-0x1000,0x3b600), motion/input fields, fills the kaze_record_table_a color table, copies stage block to kaze_staged_stage_index.

functions.name: kaze_pad_mask_update
functions.purpose: Per-frame pad read: latches previous masks into kaze_input_current_b/14, decodes both digital pad buffers (kaze_pad1_buffer/kaze_pad2_status_byte, type nibble 4) into button masks, and ORs pad 2 into the main input mask kaze_input_current_a.

functions.name: kaze_vram_clear_all
functions.purpose: Clears the whole 1024x512 VRAM as four 512x256 ClearImage rects via kaze_clear_image_rect.

functions.name: kaze_clear_image_rect
functions.purpose: GPU wrapper: builds a RECT from four shorts, ClearImage to black, DrawSync(0).

functions.name: kaze_prim_color_table_copy
functions.purpose: Copies 0x108 RGB byte triples (stride 4) from the color table at kaze_balloon_color_table_r into the primitive/color array pointed to by struct+0x8c of base.

functions.name: kaze_cd_load_file_alloc
functions.purpose: Loads a whole CD file: appends ';1', resolves via the cached lookup kaze_cd_file_lookup_cached, CdControl seek, heap-allocates a sector-rounded buffer (kaze_heap_malloc), CdRead+CdReadSync with retry; returns the buffer.

functions.name: kaze_cd_load_file_into
functions.purpose: Loads a CD file into a caller buffer with an optional byte cap: cached path lookup, CdControl seek, CdRead/CdReadSync retry loop; returns the sector-rounded byte count or retries on failure.

functions.name: kaze_cd_file_cache_root_init
functions.purpose: CdSearchFile on the root path, allocates the 0x1c-byte root record into kaze_cd_root_cache_node storing CdlLOC pos/size and name, then recursively builds the directory cache tree via kaze_cd_dir_tree_build.

functions.name: kaze_cd_dir_tree_build
functions.purpose: Recursive ISO9660 directory parser: reads sectors via kaze_cd_read_sectors, allocates 0x1c-byte records, converts extents with CdIntToPos, copies names, recurses into subdirectories to build the kaze_cd_root_cache_node file cache.

functions.name: kaze_cd_file_lookup_cached
functions.purpose: Path lookup in the cached CD directory tree at kaze_cd_root_cache_node, walking backslash-separated components and filling a CdlFILE; falls back to CdSearchFile when the cache is absent.

functions.name: kaze_cd_read_at_loc
functions.purpose: Reads a file whose CdlFILE header is hdr into dst: CdControl seek then CdRead of the sector-rounded size (capped by size); returns bytes or -1.

functions.name: kaze_cd_load_tim_upload
functions.purpose: Loads a file via kaze_cd_load_file_alloc until the first word equals the TIM magic 0x10, then uploads it through the TIM post-process kaze_cd_read_postprocess and frees the staging buffer.

functions.name: kaze_heap_alloc_dir_toggle
functions.purpose: Toggles the heap allocation-direction flag kaze_heap_alloc_direction_flag (front vs back split in the free-list allocator).

functions.name: kaze_heap_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the K&R-style free-list heap: aligns start to 8, sets head kaze_heap_free_list_head with one free block covering size bytes (unit = 8 bytes), clears kaze_heap_free_list_head_size.

functions.name: kaze_heap_malloc
functions.purpose: First-fit free-list allocator over the kaze_heap_free_list_head heap in 8-byte units; kaze_heap_alloc_direction_flag selects front- or back-of-block split. Underlies kaze_heap_alloc.

functions.name: kaze_heap_free
functions.purpose: Frees a block back into the kaze_heap_free_list_head free list, coalescing with adjacent free neighbors.

functions.name: kaze_str_movie_play
functions.purpose: Plays an STR movie: CdSearchFile, optional SsSetSerialVol, allocates buffers, streams and DecDCTin/DecDCTout each frame with VSync/PutDispEnv page flip until Start (0x800 in kaze_input_current_a) or end flag kaze_str_movie_end_flag.

functions.name: kaze_str_playback_buffers_init
functions.purpose: Allocates and zeroes the STR playback context: two 0x28000-byte VLC buffers and two 0x3c00-byte MDEC image buffers from the kaze_heap_free_list_head heap, plus display x/y/size fields and slice width 0x10 in the context struct.

functions.name: kaze_str_stream_start
functions.purpose: Starts CD movie streaming: allocates the 0x10000-byte ring kaze_str_stream_ring_buffer, DecDCTReset+DecDCToutCallback, StSetRing/StSetStream with frame count kaze_str_movie_stream_count, seeks/starts CdRead2, clears end flag kaze_str_movie_end_flag.

functions.name: kaze_str_frame_vlc_decode
functions.purpose: Fetches the next STR frame (kaze_str_next_frame_fetch), flips the VLC double-buffer index at ctx+0x8, runs DecDCTvlc into the current buffer, and StFreeRing's the sector.

functions.name: kaze_str_next_frame_fetch
functions.purpose: Polls StGetNext for the next STR frame; sets end flag kaze_str_movie_end_flag at the last frame number (kaze_str_movie_stream_count-1), clears the screen and updates cached width/height (kaze_str_frame_cached_width/kaze_str_frame_cached_height) on resolution change.

functions.name: kaze_cd_stream_seek_start
functions.purpose: Retries CdControl seek to the CdlLOC then starts continuous streaming with CdRead2(0x1c0).

functions.name: kaze_str_playback_buffers_free
functions.purpose: Frees the five STR playback heap blocks (VLC buffers kaze_str_vlc_buffer_a/c8, image buffers kaze_str_mdec_buffer_a/d4, ring kaze_str_stream_ring_buffer) with inlined coalescing free.

functions.name: kaze_loading_screen_show
functions.purpose: Shows the stage loading screen: loads \BAL\M\LOAD%d.TIM selected by staging field kaze_staged_stage_level, sets DISPENV/DRAWENV from live-root +0x2417c/+0xa8, MoveImage's the second half, DrawSync/VSync, SetDispMask(1).

functions.name: kaze_common_assets_load
functions.purpose: Loads shared assets: SSP.TIM, DEMOTEXT.TIM, TEX02/TEX01.TIM, CONSOLE.TIM into VRAM via the TIM loader, plus BALMODEL.DAT into live-root +0x509e8 and TEXTURE.TBL into +0x5ae98.

functions.name: kaze_lighting_env_frame_update
functions.purpose: Per-frame lighting pass: SetBackColor/SetFarColor, light-matrix defaults, environment color update, sun-angle update, env poly refresh, SetColorMatrix/SetLightMatrix (+0x48198/+0x481b8), NormalColor into +0x481d8..e0.

functions.name: kaze_light_matrix_defaults
functions.purpose: Writes the default light matrix at live-root +0x481b8 (rows 0xf000,0xf000,0 / 0x1000,0x1000,0 / 0,0x1000,0) and the identity color matrix at +0x48198.

functions.name: kaze_sun_angle_light_update
functions.purpose: Sun direction from stage level kaze_live_stage_level (rsin/rcos of level<<10 into light matrix +0x481be/+0x481c2, factors +0x48274/78), stage-3 ambient boosts, random UV/brightness bytes for +0x4a288..+0x4a2d1 sprites.

functions.name: kaze_stage_weather_fx_roll

functions.name: kaze_stage_completion_check

functions.name: kaze_flight_control_dispatch
functions.purpose: Per-frame control dispatcher on root+0x14 flags: 0x40000000 -> post-event menu update, 0x80000000 -> result retry prompt (kaze_result_retry_prompt), 0x200000 -> pause/exit prompt, else the burner target-gas law kaze_target_gas_law.

functions.name: kaze_burner_input_update
functions.purpose: Burner input: button (kaze_input_current_a & kaze_input_bind_burner) with gas kaze_gas>0 sets ramp kaze_burner_state (0x1000/0xe00), sound on, target kaze_target_gas=0x64000; else decays ramp, clamps target above kaze_min_gas.

functions.name: kaze_burner_sound_toggle
functions.purpose: Latches the burner loop sound on/off via the flag at live-root +0x481f8, calling kaze_sfx_voice_keyon_34108(0,0) to start and kaze_sfx_voice_keyoff_34170(0) to stop.

functions.name: kaze_terrain_collision_neighbor_query
functions.purpose: Terrain collision wrapper: converts world X/Z to 0xed8 tile coords, tests the center tile via kaze_terrain_zone_collision_query, and near tile edges/corners also tests adjacent tiles (0..0x7e), ORing direction masks into *out.

functions.name: kaze_mode_object_proximity_test
functions.purpose: Proximity test against the six +0x58e14 mode-object slots (skips the given slot index, flags 0x84000000): 3D distance with -700 Y bias; under the given vertical threshold plus 700 it sets direction bits (1/0x10, 4/0x40, 2/0x20), returns slot or -1.

functions.name: kaze_marker_slot_find_free
functions.purpose: Returns the index of the first free slot (state word 0) in the 10-slot mode-0 marker table at +0x58a74 (stride 0x5c), or -1 when full.

functions.name: kaze_marker_drop
functions.purpose: Drops a marker into +0x58a74 slot slot: decrements remaining kaze_mode_state, state 1, scale 0x100, position from balloon kaze_pos_x/dc/e0 (+0x32 Y), rotation from camera root+0x48/4a/4c, plays sound (1,1).

functions.name: kaze_camera_control_update
functions.purpose: Camera update: manual pitch/yaw from input masks (kaze_input_bind_up/1808/1ab4/17d0) with speeds kaze_camera_control_speed_x/a4; auto-look (flag 0x8000) aims root+0x48/4a/4c at the balloon; smooths +0x50/54/58 to kaze_camera_anchor_target_x/94/98.

functions.name: kaze_approach_value
functions.purpose: Moves current toward target target by at most step step; returns the new value.

functions.name: kaze_approach_angle
functions.purpose: Angle-approach helper: wraps the target into the +-0x800 range of a 0x1000-unit circle, then steps cur toward it by at most step.

functions.name: kaze_result_retry_prompt
functions.purpose: Post-result continue/retry state machine on root+0x8: Circle/Cross opens the retry prompt (selection word 0x124ae) or fast-exits in demo; Left/Right toggles, Circle confirms flag 0x4000000 (retry) or 0x8000000 (exit).

functions.name: kaze_hud_status_update
functions.purpose: Updates HUD status: +0xecae4 code (0xb no-gas, 9 terminal, -1 demo), 0x1e loop-sound latch +0x481fc; every 15 ticks altitude +0xecae8 (-y/0x96), wind meter +0xecaec, goal-proximity +0xecaf0 (100 near target).

functions.name: kaze_flight_timer_gas_update
functions.purpose: In-flight timers/gas: time +0x48284 (cap 359999), wind timer +0x48280, drains gas kaze_gas (-0x10/-0x18 with burner ramp; bonus kaze_vertical_penalty first), clamps 0..0x64000, +0xecaf8 page mod 0x1e, wind re-roll per 0x4b0.

functions.name: kaze_wind_layers_reroll
functions.purpose: Re-randomizes the five wind layers at kaze_wind_layer0_dir (stride 8): random-walk direction &7, random speed 0x50/0x28/0x14 at +4; outside the 0x7e2d..0x6efd8 play region forces one layer to point back toward map center.

functions.name: kaze_world_update_pass
functions.purpose: Per-frame world update umbrella: loads GTE matrices from the camera matrix at root+0x28, then render-vector load, post-event menu anim, HUD gauges, dynamic/mode-object and marker updates, cloth anim, landing events.

functions.name: kaze_panel_frame_vertices
functions.purpose: Writes screen XY vertex shorts for a bordered panel: inner box at (x-4,y-4), outer border at -8, size unused_w/unused_h, filling two primitive groups at p0 (+0x8..+0x76) and p1 (+0x8..+0x5a).

functions.name: kaze_radar_dot_colors_update
functions.purpose: Sets color/code bytes on the radar primitive array: POLY_F4/F3 codes with blue values 0x40/0x48/0x50/0x58, then per +0x58e14 mode-object slot picks 0x50 (active) or 0x58 (flags 0x84000000 in +0x58e58) for its dot.

functions.name: kaze_radar_range_delta
functions.purpose: Radar range test: delta from focus point root+0x68/+0x6c/+0x70 to the given object's position; within +-0x8000 all axes and horizontal distance < 0x76c1, stores short dx/dy/dz into the given output pointer and returns the distance, else -1.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_patrol_shuttle
functions.purpose: Dynamic-object two-point shuttle: moves between node positions at +0x54/+0x5c (toggle +0x70), flips heading +0x800 and waits (timer +0x48) at each end, integrates by rsin/rcos of +0x4c at speed +0x6c, turns yaw +0x2a.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_route_follow_smooth
functions.purpose: Route follower over the kaze_route_node_next_table node table (stride 0x10): at each node advances and recomputes yaw/pitch words 0x13/0x12 via ratan2 (state 1 when next<0); accelerates 0x1b to 0x1d, turns yaw +0x2a, integrates.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_fall_respawn_anim
functions.purpose: Dynamic-object fall/respawn animation: lowers Y (word 5) by fall speed +0x5c per tick while ramping phase +0x54 by 0xc; past 0x1000 resets phase and snaps Y back to base +0x58; scale words +0x30/34/38 follow the phase.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_bob_anim
functions.purpose: Dynamic-object bobbing animation: phase +0x60 advances 0xc/tick mod 0x1000; Y (word 5) = base +0x58 + rsin(phase)*amp +0x64; scale words +0x30/34/38 = 0x1000 + rsin(phase)*amp +0x68.

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_route_follow_direct
functions.purpose: Simplified kaze_route_node_next_table route follower: same node-advance/yaw-pitch computation and acceleration as the smooth variant but integrates position directly from words 0x12/0x13 without model turn smoothing (flying objects).

functions.name: kaze_dynobj_state_timer
functions.purpose: Dynamic-object timer: resets word 0x18 when trigger word 3 is clear or pause flag 0x2000000 is set, else accumulates by the vsync divisor and switches the slot to state 3 when threshold word 0x19 is reached.

functions.name: kaze_marker_attach_to_dynobj
functions.purpose: Attaches a completed marker to dynamic object idx: sets marker state 0x81000000, stores the object index at word 0xe and the marker-minus-object offset (from +0x5901c slot pos +0x5902c/30/34) into words 0xf..0x11.

functions.name: kaze_trail_particle_update
functions.purpose: Updates the 128-slot trail/smoke particle pool at +0x5988c (stride 0x2c): advances life 0x20/tick, expires past 0x1000, computes visibility and camera-relative short deltas from root +0x68/+0x6c/+0x70 within 0x76c0.

functions.name: kaze_trail_particle_spawn
functions.purpose: Spawns one +0x5988c trail particle at position pos, reusing the first free slot or the oldest (max life word 10); called from the balloon physics snapshot, marker update, and mode-object update.

functions.name: kaze_flight_scene_render_dispatch
functions.purpose: Main flight-scene render dispatcher: demo overlay, result banners by flags 0x400000/0x800000/0x2000000, post-event bg/prims, balloon, mode objects, markers, dynamic objects, fx, trail particles, terrain+water, sky.

functions.name: kaze_trail_particle_render
functions.purpose: Renders the 128 +0x5988c trail particles as semi-trans POLY_FT4 billboards: TPage(0x200,0x100)/CLUT(0x1c0,0x1f9), yaw/pitch billboard matrix from root+0x48/+0x4a, color from ambient +0x481d8..e0 clamped 0x30..0xff.

functions.name: kaze_prim_buffer_append
functions.purpose: Appends a count-word GPU packet into the frame primitive buffer at live-root +0x9c (cursor advance), writing the length/link header and re-linking the caller's tag ot to the new packet.

functions.name: kaze_sky_cloud_quads_render
functions.purpose: Renders the 0x40-entry sky cloud layer at +0x506d4 as shade-tex POLY_FT4 quads: CLUT row from stage level kaze_live_stage_level, billboard tilt from camera pitch +0x4a via +0x508d4, altitude -0x1000-y, via kaze_quad_subdivide_render.

functions.name: kaze_terrain_render_setup
functions.purpose: Terrain render wrapper: builds camera-local translation from balloon position mod 0xed8 (root+0x68/+0x6c/+0x70) via RotTrans, sets GTE matrices, runs terrain tile renderer kaze_terrain_tile_render and water pass kaze_env_water_render_pass.

functions.name: kaze_terrain_tile_window_cull
functions.purpose: Rebuilds the 8x8 visible-tile window at +0xec6e0 from the 0x80-wide tile map at +0x5b6e0 around the balloon tile (pos/0xed8), zeroing tiles outside the camera-yaw FOV wedge or masked out in kaze_terrain_tile_cull_mask.

functions.name: kaze_tile_edge_factor
functions.purpose: Computes a 0..0xed sub-tile edge factor from balloon position in its tile (pos%0xed8>>4), mirrored/halved by direction-mask bits (X: 0x80/0x10/0x40/0x20, Z: 8/1/4/2), returns the max; for terrain seam blending.

functions.name: kaze_water_quad_subdivide_render
functions.purpose: Subdividing textured-quad renderer for the water pass: projects 4 SVECTOR+UV vertices, clip-tests via kaze_quad_screen_clip_test, splits at midpoints (kaze_vertex_midpoint_lerp) when too large/clipped, emits POLY_FT3 tris via kaze_gte_emit_textured_tri.

functions.name: kaze_gte_emit_textured_tri
functions.purpose: GTE helper: rtpt-projects three SVECTORs and emits one POLY_FT3 packet (code 0x24) with UVs from vertex pad bytes and CLUT/TPage from ctx +0x8a/+0x92 into the packet buffer at ctx+0x40, tag-linking through ctx+0x44.

functions.name: kaze_quad_screen_clip_test
functions.purpose: Screen clip/size test for a projected quad: builds min/max X into ctx+0x74/76 and Y into +0x78/7a from the four SXYs; returns 1 (reject/subdivide) when any SZ > 0x7c or the bbox is outside 0..0x140 x 0..0xf0, else 0.

functions.name: kaze_vertex_midpoint_lerp
functions.purpose: Averages two SVECTOR+UV vertices into a midpoint: (x,y,z) shorts and the two texture-coordinate bytes stored in the pad field.

functions.name: kaze_quad_subdivide_render
functions.purpose: Recursive subdividing POLY_FT4 quad renderer: projects 4 SVECTOR+UV vertices, clip-tests via kaze_quad_screen_clip_test, emits an FT4 packet into ctx+0x40 when small/at depth 4, else recurses on midpoint subquads (sky clouds).

functions.name: kaze_gte_poly_project_clip_1424
functions.purpose: GTE poly projection/clip helper: ldv3/rtpt a tri, stores screen XY into a primitive struct (param+0x40), clips to screen bounds, builds a POLY with draw TPage/mode and links it into the OT.

functions.name: kaze_hud_two_digit_counter_284c
functions.purpose: Renders a two-digit numeric readout (value/100 or /60 for time) as LINE_F2 digit primitives plus tile markers with GetClut; a format-mode argument selects distance/altitude vs time formatting.

functions.name: kaze_postevent_banner_addprim_32f98
functions.purpose: AddPrims the post-event banner/overlay primitives at live-root +0x4a128/+0x4a158/+0x4a180 for the current page (+0x98), tinting the +0x4a128 fill by the fade value +0xed428.

functions.name: kaze_sound_system_init
functions.purpose: Sound subsystem init: allocates the 0x14b20 sound work area into kaze_sound_state_base_ptr, configures serial/tick/reverb (SpuInitHot, SsUtSetReverb), zeroes CD-audio state, CdMix; calls kaze_xa_stream_enable_33b0/kaze_xa_file_table_init_331c.

functions.name: kaze_xa_file_table_init_331c
functions.purpose: Builds the XA/streamed-audio CD file-location table at kaze_xa_file_loc_table by resolving \BAL\STR\BALXA01.XA entries (kaze_cd_file_lookup_cached) into packed 24-bit CdlLOC fields.

functions.name: kaze_xa_stream_enable_33b0
functions.purpose: Enables CD/XA streaming: sets flag kaze_sound_state_base_ptr+0x14afc=1 and calls PsyQ stream helper kaze_ss_set_stereo.

functions.name: kaze_xa_stream_disable_33e8
functions.purpose: Disables CD/XA streaming: clears flag kaze_sound_state_base_ptr+0x14afc=0 and calls PsyQ stream helper kaze_ss_set_mono.

functions.name: kaze_cd_setmode_vsync_341c
functions.purpose: Issues a blocking CdControlB mode command (0x0e, param 200) followed by VSync(5) during CD/XA audio setup.

functions.name: kaze_xa_track_seek_setup_3454
functions.purpose: Resolves an XA track's CD location from kaze_xa_file_loc_table (CdPosToInt), stores start/end sectors at +0x14b00..+0x14b08, and issues CdControlB read/seek (0x0d/0x15) after kaze_cd_audio_set_volume_33c58 mutes.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0
functions.purpose: Per-frame XA audio manager keyed on current track +0x14b18: stops (CdControlF pause) on -1, fades/polls the active track (kaze_xa_audio_fade_in_33bac/kaze_xa_audio_loop_poll_33690), starts a new track (kaze_xa_audio_start_track_3384c), or queues via kaze_xa_audio_fade_out_33ae8.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_loop_poll_33690
functions.purpose: XA audio playback state machine: every 0x1f frames polls CdSync/CdLastCom and re-issues seek/read/loop commands (0x11/0x15/0x1b) to keep the streamed track between +0x14b04 and +0x14b08.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_start_track_3384c
functions.purpose: Starts an XA audio track: sets current track +0x14b18, resolves its CD start/end sectors, and issues CdControlF read (0x0d) after muting via kaze_cd_audio_set_volume_33c58.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_seek_resume_339a8
functions.purpose: Seeks/resumes the active XA track: sets target volume +0x14b0c=0x7f, seeks (CdControlF 0x15) to +0x14b00, and sets the playing flag +0x14b10=1.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_stop_33a3c
functions.purpose: Stops XA audio playback: CdControl pause/standby (0x09/0x08), clears volume/playing flags +0x14b0c/+0x14b10/+0x14b14, and resets current track +0x14b18 to -1.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_fade_out_33ae8
functions.purpose: XA audio fade-out step: decreases the CD-audio volume +0x14b0c toward 0 (clamped 0..0x7f) via kaze_cd_audio_set_volume_33c58; releases the track when it reaches 0.

functions.name: kaze_xa_audio_fade_in_33bac
functions.purpose: XA audio fade-in step: increases the CD-audio volume +0x14b0c toward 0x7f (clamped) and applies it via kaze_cd_audio_set_volume_33c58 while the play flag +0x14b14 is set.

functions.name: kaze_cd_audio_set_volume_33c58
functions.purpose: Sets CD-audio mix volume: clamps param to 0..0x80, writes the CdlATV L/R fields +0x14af8/+0x14afa, mirrors to +0x14b0c, and applies via CdMix (zeroed when mute flag +0x14afc set).

functions.name: kaze_seq_vab_bank_load_33d2c
functions.purpose: Loads a per-map SEQ/VAB sound bank from BAL\MAP\BALOON tables: opens VH (SsVabOpenHeadSticky), transfers VB body (SsVabTransBody), opens the SEP sequence (SsSepOpen), storing handles at +0x14ac4/+0x14ac6.

functions.name: kaze_seq_vab_bank_close_33f58
functions.purpose: Closes the current SEQ/VAB sound bank: SsSepClose the SEP handle +0x14ac6, SsUtAllKeyOff, SsVabClose the VAB handle +0x14ac4, and resets bank id +0x14ac0.

functions.name: kaze_seq_reset_track_volumes_34048
functions.purpose: Resets all SEP sequence track volumes to 0 (SsSepSetVol loop over +0x14ac8 tracks) and clears the per-track volume cache at +0x14acc.

functions.name: kaze_sfx_voice_keyon_34108
functions.purpose: Triggers a one-shot SFX voice via SsVoKeyOn on the current VAB (+0x14ac4) and note table kaze_sfx_note_table; optionally keys off first (kaze_sfx_voice_keyoff_34170).

functions.name: kaze_sfx_voice_keyoff_34170
functions.purpose: Keys off an SFX voice via SsVoKeyOff on the current VAB handle +0x14ac4 and note table kaze_sfx_note_table.

functions.name: kaze_play_sound_effect
functions.purpose: Plays a sound effect: sets SEP track volume (SsSepSetVol, cached at +0x14acc) and starts/replays the track (SsSepStop/SsSepPlay) on the current SEP handle +0x14ac6. Anchor: plays a sound effect.

functions.name: kaze_seq_stop_track_34310
functions.purpose: Stops SEP sequence track(s): for param<0 stops all +0x14ac8 tracks, else the given track, zeroing volume cache +0x14acc and calling SsSepSetVol(0)/SsSepStop.

functions.name: kaze_menu_settings_trampoline_34458
functions.purpose: Thin trampoline into the title/settings-menu neighborhood; simply calls kaze_game_menu_master_loop.

functions.name: kaze_demo_attract_runner_34478
functions.purpose: Attract/demo mode runner: randomizes the menu staging block kaze_staged_stage_index..kaze_staged_stage_variant (mode/level/variant, timers 0x3ae94) and repeatedly runs the main loop kaze_main_game_loop(1) until kaze_title_screen_loop breaks.

functions.name: kaze_state_oneshot_trigger_34580
functions.purpose: One-shot state transition: when an unnamed flight-state flag reaches 1, it invokes kaze_ending_screen_loop and advances that same flag to 2.

functions.name: kaze_prim_ot_link_insert_345bc
functions.purpose: Ordering-table/primitive-list splice helper: rewrites 24-bit next-pointers to insert p1's primitive into the chain terminated at p3 (0xffffff terminator).

functions.name: kaze_tmd_model_relocate_3462c
functions.purpose: Relocates a loaded TMD/model in place: verifies the -1 magic, sets the relocated bit, and rebases 20 submodel pointer triples plus the vertex/normal arrays by the model base address.

functions.name: kaze_model_set_rotation_component_3489c
functions.purpose: Setter: writes arg2<<16 (fixed point) into the model draw struct rotation array at arg0+8+idx*4 consumed by the model draw dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_model_set_translation_component_348b0
functions.purpose: Setter: writes arg2<<16 (fixed point) into the model draw struct translation array at arg0+0x28+idx*4 consumed by the model draw dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_model_get_field_348ec
functions.purpose: Getter: reads the short at model draw struct offset arg0+0x2a+idx*4 into *arg2.

functions.name: kaze_draw_model
functions.purpose: Master model draw dispatch: sets up GTE draw/light state in the 1F800xxx scratchpad, copies rotation/translation/scale arrays (+8/+0x28/+0x48), then dispatches each submodel to its primitive rasterizer. Anchor: draws...

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_f3_4f98

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_f3_semitrans_352c4

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_g3_355ac
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud triangles (gte_stsxy3_g3, gte_ncct_b, gte_strgb3 three colors, POLY code 0x30/0x32000000) with per-vertex RGB modulation.

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_g3_semitrans_35a54
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud triangles semi-transparent variant (gte_stsxy3_g3/ncct/strgb3, POLY code 0x32000000, stride 0x24).

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_g3_pervtx_35ec4
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud triangles lit per-vertex (three gte_ldv0/nccs/strgb passes) with POLY code 0x30/0x32000000, stride 0x1c.

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_g3_pervtx_semitrans_363b0
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud triangles lit per-vertex, semi-transparent variant (gte_stsxy3_g3, POLY code 0x32000000, stride 0x24).

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_g3_3normal_36864
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud triangles with three separate vertex normals (ldv0/ldrgb/nccs x3), POLY code 0x30/0x32000000, stride 0x1c.

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_g3_3normal_semitrans_36d68
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud triangles with three vertex normals, semi-transparent variant (gte_stsxy3_g3, POLY code 0x32000000, stride 0x24).

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_ft3_37234
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: textured flat triangles (gte_stsxy3_g3/ncs, TPage/CLUT at +0x36, POLY code 0x7000000) with texture-window fields.

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_gt3_375ac
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: textured gouraud triangles (gte_stsxy3_gt3, gte_nct_b, strgb3, TPage/CLUT, POLY code 0x9000000).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_f4_37ab8
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: flat-shaded quads (rtpt+rtps 4th vertex, gte_stsxy3_f3+stsxy, avsz4, nccs, POLY code 0x5000000, stride 0x18).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_f4_semitrans_37dd8
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: flat-shaded quads semi-transparent variant (avsz4 quad, gte_stsxy3_f3, POLY code 0x5000000, stride 0x20).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_g4_38124
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud quads (rtpt+rtps 4th vertex, gte_stsxy3_g3, gte_ncct + extra nccs, strgb3, POLY code 0x38/0x3a000000, stride 0x24).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_g4_38720
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud quads (gte_stsxy3_g3 quad path, avsz4, per-vertex RGB modulation, POLY code 0x38000000-family).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_g4_semitrans_38cc0
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud quads semi-transparent variant (gte_stsxy3_g3 quad, POLY code 0x38/0x3a000000).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_g4_392d4
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud quads variant (gte_stsxy3_g3 quad path with per-vertex normals, POLY code 0x38000000-family).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_g4_39898
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud quads variant (gte_stsxy3_g3 quad, per-vertex lighting, POLY code 0x38/0x3a000000).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_g4_semitrans_39ef4
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: gouraud quads semi-transparent variant (gte_stsxy3_g3 quad, POLY code 0x3a000000).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_ft4_3a500
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: textured quads (rtpt+rtps 4th vertex, gte_stsxy3_g3, avsz4_b, TPage/CLUT from +0x33 &0xfe000000).

functions.name: kaze_model_quad_gt4_3a904
functions.purpose: TMD submodel rasterizer: textured gouraud quads (gte_stsxy3_gt3 quad path, TPage/CLUT, per-vertex color, POLY code 0x9000000-family).

functions.name: kaze_model_tri_f3_nolight_3af60

functions.purpose: SetPolyF4 semi-transparent quad plus DR_TPAGE at kaze_fade_overlay_quad_table/7230 with GetTPage(abr) (fade overlay quad).

functions.name: kaze_quad_addprim_color
functions.purpose: Sets RGB of overlay quad kaze_fade_overlay_quad_table and AddPrims the quad+tpage into the OT bucket.

functions.name: kaze_quad_addprim_texpage
functions.purpose: Sets quad color, GetTPage/SetDrawTPage, and AddPrims the quad+tpage into the OT bucket.

functions.name: kaze_tim_load_to_vram
functions.purpose: Validates TIM magic 0x10, GsGetTimInfo then LoadImage of pixel data and CLUT to VRAM at optional override coords.

functions.name: kaze_backbuffer_copy_offscreen
functions.purpose: GsGetActiveBuff + MoveImage copies the active 0x140x0xf0 back buffer to offscreen VRAM (0x280,0).

functions.name: kaze_linef3_init
functions.purpose: SetLineF3/SetShadeTex initializes 4 LINE_F3 gradient bars at kaze_linef3_gradient_bar_table_a/7310; resets phase kaze_linef3_gradient_bar_phase.

functions.name: kaze_linef3_gradient_bar
functions.purpose: Fills a LINE_F3 gradient bar's vertices, sets rsin-animated color from phase kaze_linef3_gradient_bar_phase, and AddPrims it.

functions.name: kaze_rand_range
functions.purpose: Returns a random integer between the two given bounds, inclusive, computed as (rand()*rand()) mod the span plus the lower bound.

functions.name: kaze_uint_to_decimal_string
functions.purpose: Converts a uint to a fixed-width decimal ASCII string with optional leading-zero-to-space padding.

functions.name: kaze_input_edge_detect
functions.purpose: Polls the pad (kaze_pad_mask_update), latches kaze_input_current_a/kaze_input_current_b, computes newly-pressed mask kaze_input_edge and hold counter kaze_input_hold_timer.

functions.name: kaze_file_load_by_name
functions.purpose: Prepends drive prefix kaze_file_path_drive_prefix to a path and loads that file from CD via kaze_cd_load_file_alloc.

functions.name: kaze_tim_display_by_name
functions.purpose: Loads a TIM file by name (prefix kaze_file_path_drive_prefix) and displays it at default position via kaze_cd_load_tim_upload.

functions.name: kaze_txp_archive_load_vram
functions.purpose: Loads a TXP archive by name via kaze_cd_load_file_alloc and LoadImage-uploads every TIM entry to VRAM, then frees it.

functions.name: kaze_sfx_play_dispatch
functions.purpose: Plays a sound effect: kaze_play_sound_effect for id<100, else kaze_sfx_voice_keyon_34108(id-100).

functions.name: kaze_sfx_stop_dispatch
functions.purpose: Stops/updates a sound effect: kaze_seq_stop_track_34310 for id<100, else kaze_sfx_voice_keyoff_34170(id-100).

functions.name: kaze_memcard_events_open
functions.purpose: OpenEvent/EnableEvent for 8 memory-card events (both slots) stored at kaze_memcard_slot0_event_a..a4.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_events_close
functions.purpose: CloseEvent the 8 memory-card events at kaze_memcard_slot0_event_a..a4.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_slot_poll_start
functions.purpose: Issues _card_info/_card_load/_card_clear for a slot depending on state bits in kaze_memcard_slot_request_state.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_state_machine
functions.purpose: Polls memcard events (TestEvent) and advances slot state kaze_memcard_slot_request_state with retry counter kaze_memcard_poll_retry_count.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_result_decode
functions.purpose: Decodes a memcard poll result into per-slot status bits at kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_probe_blocking
functions.purpose: Blocking _card_info/_card_load probe using kaze_memcard_wait_result_a event wait; returns memcard status code.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_format
functions.purpose: Builds the device name from kaze_memcard_device_path and format()s the memory card, waiting for the result event.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_file_read
functions.purpose: open()/read()s a save file (blocks<<13 bytes) from the memory-card device path kaze_memcard_device_path.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_file_write
functions.purpose: Optionally creates then open()/write()s a save file (blocks<<13 bytes) to the memory-card device.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_file_count
functions.purpose: firstfile/nextfile enumerates matching card files into kaze_memcard_directory_table and returns the count.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_free_blocks
functions.purpose: Sums file sizes in card directory kaze_memcard_directory_table and returns free block count (15 - used).

functions.name: kaze_memcard_find_file
functions.purpose: Linear-searches the card directory kaze_memcard_directory_table for a filename match; returns 1 if found.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_wait_result_a
functions.purpose: Spins on TestEvent(kaze_memcard_slot0_event_a..94) returning result code 0-3 with timeout counter kaze_memcard_wait_timeout_count.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_clear_events_a
functions.purpose: TestEvent-drains the 4 primary memcard events kaze_memcard_slot0_event_a..94.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_wait_result_b
functions.purpose: Spins on TestEvent(kaze_memcard_slot1_event_a..a4) returning result code 0-3 for the second event bank.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_clear_events_b
functions.purpose: TestEvent-drains the 4 secondary memcard events kaze_memcard_slot1_event_a..a4.

functions.name: kaze_input_edge_detect_memcard
functions.purpose: Input edge detection (like kaze_input_edge_detect) that overrides with a memcard confirm case; sets kaze_input_edge/kaze_input_hold_timer.

functions.name: kaze_title_screen_loop
functions.purpose: Title/opening screen main loop: init, per-frame GsClearOt/GsSwapDispBuff/GsDrawOt, dispatch kaze_title_state_render_dispatch by state kaze_title_screen_state until kaze_title_screen_state==-1.

functions.name: kaze_title_screen_init
functions.purpose: Allocates buffers (kaze_heap_alloc), loads BAL\K\TITLE.TXP, sets flat light/ambient and initial title state kaze_title_screen_state=1.

functions.name: kaze_title_screen_cleanup
functions.purpose: Frees title buffers kaze_title_pressstart_sprite_buffer/e8 and optional kaze_opening_model_file_ptr model; sets kaze_title_screen_cleanup_flag=1.

functions.name: kaze_title_state_render_dispatch
functions.purpose: Dispatches per-state render kaze_title_menu_substate/c678/cb9c by title state kaze_title_screen_state (1/2/3).

functions.name: kaze_title_model_buffers_alloc
functions.purpose: Allocates and copies 5 model/OT buffers (0x14a0 bytes) from kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer into kaze_title_model_buffer_ptrs for the title.

functions.name: kaze_title_model_buffers_free
functions.purpose: Copies the 5 title model buffers back to kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer and frees kaze_title_model_buffer_ptrs entries.

functions.name: kaze_title_menu_substate
functions.purpose: Title state-1 substate machine (kaze_title_start_flow_state): kaze_title_check_savedata/c4bc/c4e0/c4fc for press-start handling.

functions.name: kaze_title_check_savedata
functions.purpose: Checks save presence via kaze_memcard_load_records/kaze_title_screen_cleanup_flag, sets substate kaze_title_start_flow_state, and builds the press-start sprite.

functions.name: kaze_title_wait_input
functions.purpose: If any button was pressed (kaze_input_edge) advance title substate kaze_title_start_flow_state to 0xff.

functions.name: kaze_title_goto_state2
functions.purpose: Sets title substate 0 and advances state kaze_title_screen_state=2.

functions.name: kaze_title_pressstart_draw
functions.purpose: Thin wrapper calling kaze_pressstart_sprite_addprim to AddPrim the press-start sprite.

functions.name: kaze_pressstart_sprite_setup
functions.purpose: SetSprt/GetClut/GetTPage builds the press-start SPRT+DR_TPAGE at kaze_title_pressstart_sprite_buffer for both buffers.

functions.name: kaze_pressstart_sprite_addprim
functions.purpose: AddPrims the press-start SPRT and its DR_TPAGE (kaze_title_pressstart_sprite_buffer[+0/+0x14]) into the OT.

functions.name: kaze_title_state2_substate
functions.purpose: Title state-2 substate machine (kaze_title_start_flow_state): kaze_title_state2_init/c7ac/c948 plus render kaze_title_state2_fade_draw.

functions.name: kaze_title_state2_init
functions.purpose: Inits state-2 fade vars, calls kaze_title_sprite_setup_b sprite setup and kaze_drmove_pair_setup_a064 buffer-copy, VSyncs.

functions.name: kaze_title_state2_update
functions.purpose: State-2 timer/START(0x800) handling and fade sequencing via kaze_title_idle_timer/4c/54; sets exit kaze_title_start_skip_flag.

functions.name: kaze_title_state2_advance
functions.purpose: Advances title state kaze_title_screen_state=kaze_title_next_state and increments kaze_title_press_start_cycle_count.

functions.name: kaze_title_state2_fade_draw
functions.purpose: Fades sprite alpha kaze_start_map_transition_alpha and AddPrims (kaze_quad_addprim_texpage/a0ec) the title logo for state 2.

functions.name: kaze_title_sprite_setup_b
functions.purpose: SetSprt/GetClut/GetTPage builds a second SPRT+DR_TPAGE (offset +0x1c/+0x30) at kaze_title_pressstart_sprite_buffer.

functions.name: kaze_title_sprite_blink_addprim
functions.purpose: AddPrims the +0x1c/+0x30 sprite while blink phase kaze_title_blink_phase < 0x3c.

functions.name: kaze_opening_state_dispatch
functions.purpose: Opening/demo state-3 substate machine: kaze_opening_demo_init/cea8/cd54 plus render kaze_opening_demo_draw.

functions.name: kaze_opening_demo_init
functions.purpose: Loads BAL\K\OPN.MDL/OPN.TXP opening model+texture, resets camera/altitude vars, starts music (kaze_cd_setmode_vsync_341c).

functions.name: kaze_opening_demo_update
functions.purpose: Opening cinematic update: altitude kaze_menu_camera_scroll end and START|X (0x840) skip, camera kaze_opening_camera_keyframe/d2f4, fade kaze_start_map_transition_alpha.

functions.name: kaze_opening_demo_exit
functions.purpose: Exits the opening cinematic to state 2 and stops music (kaze_xa_audio_stop_33a3c).

functions.name: kaze_opening_demo_draw
functions.purpose: Fades the opening overlay sprite (kaze_start_map_transition_alpha) and sorts the opening model via kaze_opening_model_sort/kaze_title_model_sort_dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_opening_model_link
functions.purpose: GsMapModelingData/GsInitCoordinate2/GsLinkObject4 sets up the opening balloon model kaze_opening_model_file_ptr for rendering.

functions.name: kaze_opening_model_sort
functions.purpose: RotMatrix/GsGetLws/GsSortObject4 sorts the opening model kaze_opening_model_link_handle into the frame OT.

functions.name: kaze_opening_camera_keyframe
functions.purpose: Advances the opening camera keyframe from table kaze_opening_camera_keyframe_alt_table by altitude kaze_menu_camera_scroll, computing per-frame position/angle deltas.

functions.name: kaze_opening_camera_view
functions.purpose: Interpolates opening camera position/angles with rsin/rcos, builds view matrix via RotMatrixZYX and GsSetView2.

functions.name: kaze_start_map_screen_init
functions.purpose: Clears the screen, allocates buffers, randomizes start (kaze_rand_range), sets cursor kaze_map_cursor_screen_x/30/34/38, and runs map sub-inits.

functions.name: kaze_start_map_cursor_move
functions.purpose: Moves the start-location map cursor/box (kaze_map_cursor_screen_x/30/34/38) per D-pad masks kaze_input_edge/kaze_input_current_c with bounds clamping.

functions.name: kaze_map_cursor_confirm_input
functions.purpose: Map-screen cursor-state input: dpad/Cross clears banner index kaze_map_feedback_state; Circle checks validity kaze_map_location_valid - invalid shows banner 2 + error sound, valid sets map state kaze_map_state=3 and banner 1 (first confirm).

functions.name: kaze_map_panel_scroll_update
functions.purpose: Updates the 256x160 map panel SPRT v-texture offset (kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer + buf*0x14 +0xc/+0xd) for vertical map scrolling from cursor-y kaze_map_cursor_screen_y edges (0x20/0xbe) and scroll kaze_map_cursor_z; otherwise copies the other buffer.

functions.name: kaze_map_second_confirm_input
functions.purpose: Map-screen second-confirm input: Circle advances map state kaze_map_state to 5 (commit path); Cross cancels back to cursor state 2 and clears banner kaze_map_feedback_state; plays confirm/cancel sounds via kaze_sfx_play_dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_map_fade_in_state
functions.purpose: Map-screen fade-in state renderer: steps fade level kaze_map_fade_counter down by 7 and draws the fade quad (kaze_map_fade_quad_draw), frame lines, map tiles, and map panel.

functions.name: kaze_map_cursor_state_draw
functions.purpose: Map-screen cursor-state draw pass: cursor sprite, scroll arrows, message banner (index kaze_map_feedback_state), frame lines, map tiles, wind-direction overlay, and map panel.

functions.name: kaze_map_confirm_state_draw
functions.purpose: Map-screen confirm-state draw pass: pulsing target marker instead of the cursor, plus message banner, frame lines, map tiles, wind overlay, and map panel.

functions.name: kaze_map_fade_out_state
functions.purpose: Map-screen fade-out state: draws the fade quad with rising kaze_map_fade_counter (+8/frame) and sets map state kaze_map_state=9 (exit) once past 0xff; also draws frame lines, tiles, and panel.

functions.name: kaze_map_screen_free_buffers
functions.purpose: Map-screen teardown: frees the two OT buffers kaze_map_ot_heap_alloc_a/kaze_map_ot_heap_alloc_b and the primitive buffer kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer via kaze_heap_free, then nulls kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer.

functions.name: kaze_map_panel_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits per-buffer map primitives in kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer: 256x160 map panel SPRT at (-0x80,-0x58) with clut(0x140,499), DR_TPAGE, and two colored LINE_F3 frame lines.

functions.name: kaze_map_cursor_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the map cursor SPRT_16 pair per buffer (valid/invalid variants, tiles (0xc0,0x60)/(0xc0,0x70), clut(0x160,0x1f1)) plus DR_TPAGE at +0x98..+0xd8 of kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer.

functions.name: kaze_map_target_marker_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the semi-transparent 8x8 target-marker SPRT_8 (tile 0xd0/0x70, clut(0x180,0x1f1)) plus DR_TPAGE per buffer at +0xe8/+0x108 of kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer.

functions.name: kaze_map_scroll_arrow_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the two blinking scroll-arrow SPRT_8 icons per buffer (+0x118, tile v 0x60/0x68, clut(0x170,0x1f1)) with up/down positions near the panel edge and a DR_TPAGE at +0x158.

functions.name: kaze_map_banner_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the 6-variant 256x16 message banner SPRTs per buffer (+0x168, v0=i*16, y 0x50, clut(0x140,0x1f1)) plus DR_TPAGE and two LINE_F3 underline frames.

functions.name: kaze_map_wind_overlay_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the 7x10 grid of semi-transparent POLY_FT4 wind-direction arrow quads per buffer (+0x2c8, clut(0x150,0x1f1), tpage(0x2c0,0x100)) used by the map wind overlay.

functions.name: kaze_map_wind_quad_reset
functions.purpose: Resets one wind-overlay quad's vertex positions for the grid cell at the given column and row, in 32px cells, with alternate diagonal layouts when direction mode kaze_map_selected_wind is 2 or 6.

functions.name: kaze_map_tile_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits map background tile SPRTs per buffer from the 8x10 presence table kaze_map_bg_tile_present_table (32x32 tiles from origin (-0xa0,-0x78), clut(0x140,0x1f2)) plus DR_TPAGE at +0x1ee8.

functions.name: kaze_map_panel_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the map panel SPRT (+buf*0x14) and its DR_TPAGE (+0x28) into the map-screen OT (&kaze_map_screen_prim_ot_ptr)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_map_frame_lines_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the two LINE_F3 map frame lines (+0x38/+0x68 of kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer) into the map-screen OT.

functions.name: kaze_map_cursor_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the map cursor: picks the valid/invalid SPRT_16 via kaze_map_location_valid, positions it at raw cursor (kaze_map_cursor_screen_x-0xa0, kaze_map_cursor_screen_y-0x78), AddPrims it plus its TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_map_target_marker_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the pulsing 8x8 target marker at the even-rounded cursor position with green brightness from rsin(kaze_map_target_marker_pulse_phase); advances the pulse phase by 0x30 mod 0xfff.

functions.name: kaze_map_scroll_arrow_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the blinking scroll arrows: up icon when the map panel v0 != 0, down icon when v0 != 0x60, red channel pulsed via kaze_map_scroll_arrow_pulse (+8 mod 0x100), plus TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_map_banner_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the selected message banner SPRT (+0x168 + the given banner index*0x14, index from kaze_map_feedback_state), its DR_TPAGE, and the two banner LINE_F3 frames.

functions.name: kaze_map_wind_overlay_anim
functions.purpose: Animates the 7x10 map wind overlay: 8-direction scroll (dir kaze_map_selected_wind, phase kaze_map_wind_overlay_phase 0..0x1f, cell reset via kaze_map_wind_quad_reset) with rsin(kaze_map_wind_overlay_angle) brightness; AddPrims all 70 quads.

functions.name: kaze_map_tiles_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the map background tile SPRTs flagged present in the kaze_map_bg_tile_present_table 8x10 table plus the tile DR_TPAGE (+0x1ee8).

functions.name: kaze_map_fade_quad_init
functions.purpose: Inits the full-screen fade POLY_F4 (semi-trans, -0xa0..0xa0 x -0x78..0x78) at +0x1ef8 per buffer plus a DR_TPAGE using GetTPage(1,mode,0,0) as blend rate.

functions.name: kaze_map_fade_quad_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the full-screen fade quad: writes RGB=val into the +0x1ef8 POLY_F4 of buffer idx and AddPrims it plus its TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_static_map_screen_init
functions.purpose: Static start-map screen init (kaze_start_location_skip_path skip path): clears VRAM, allocates OT headers + 0x1fa8 prim buffer kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer, zeroes input mask kaze_input_edge and latches, sets kaze_map_state=4 fade 0xff, inits fade+bg prims.

functions.name: kaze_static_map_screen_update
functions.purpose: Static start-map screen states: 4 fades in to 6, 6 waits for Circle (kaze_input_edge & 0x20) then 5 fades out to exit state 9 (kaze_map_state); draws the background via kaze_static_map_bg_draw.

functions.name: kaze_static_map_screen_free
functions.purpose: Frees the static start-map screen OT buffers kaze_map_ot_heap_alloc_a/kaze_map_ot_heap_alloc_b and the prim buffer kaze_map_screen_prim_buffer via kaze_heap_free.

functions.name: kaze_static_map_bg_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the full-screen background image as a 0x100+0x40 wide x 0xf0 tall SPRT pair per buffer at +0x1f38 (cluts (0x140,499); TPages 0x2c0/0x340) with DR_TPAGEs at +0x1f88.

functions.name: kaze_static_map_bg_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the full-screen background SPRT pair (+0x1f38) and their DR_TPAGEs (+0x1f88) for buffer idx.

functions.name: kaze_game_menu_master_loop
functions.purpose: Game-menu master loop: loads MBG.TIM + GM.MDL/GM.TXP, fades in, dispatches kaze_menu_screen_mode modes (0 main select, 1 setup, 2/4/5 sub-screens) until 8/9; on 9 commits settings via kaze_settings_menu_dispatch; frees model, returns state !...

functions.name: kaze_game_menu_mode_init
functions.purpose: Menu mode init: kaze_menu_screen_mode=0 normally or 5 when the skip/replay flag kaze_staged_stage_variant is set; mirrors that into kaze_grid_select_reentry_flag and sets kaze_game_menu_entered_flag=1.

functions.name: kaze_menu_bg_tim_load
functions.purpose: Loads the menu background image BAL\K\MBG.TIM and applies palette/display setup via kaze_drmove_pair_setup_a064(0x140,0) and kaze_semitrans_quad_setup(2).

functions.name: kaze_menu_fade_transition
functions.purpose: Menu fade with its own VSync/GsOT loop: param 0 fades in (kaze_menu_fade_transition_alpha 0xff down past -0x10), param 1 fades out (0 up past 0x10f) via the kaze_quad_addprim_color overlay, silencing BGM (kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0(-1,1)).

functions.name: kaze_menu_model_load
functions.purpose: Loads the menu model pack BAL\K\GM.MDL, resolves six section pointers (kaze_menu_balloon_model_ptr, kaze_menu_mode_preview_tim_table, kaze_menu_task_model_ptr, and three further unnamed model-pack pointer slots), then loads BAL\K\GM.TXP textures.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_color_apply
functions.purpose: Applies the selected balloon color scheme: copies 264 RGB triples from PRM entry (&kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer)[kaze_task_record_index] (stride 0x14) into the kaze_balloon_color_table_r color array.

functions.name: kaze_menu_model_free
functions.purpose: Frees the menu model buffer kaze_menu_model_ptr (GM.MDL) via kaze_heap_free.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_prm_load
functions.purpose: Loads the balloon design pack BAL\K\BALL.PRM (BALL2.PRM when (kaze_input_current_c & 0xf)==0xf), builds the entry pointer table at kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer, then calls kaze_record_table_reset_defaults.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_loop
functions.purpose: Main menu top screen loop (menu mode 0): own VSync/GsOT render loop over sub-state kaze_main_menu_substate (0 intro scroll, 1 item select), exits at 3; keeps BGM 0xd playing via kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_init
functions.purpose: Main menu init: zeroes sub-state/selection/animation vars from kaze_main_menu_substate through kaze_main_menu_state_timer, sets an unnamed menu-init flag just before kaze_main_menu_titlebar_sprite to 2, then inits the title-bar, item-panel, item-icon, and item-label primitives.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_intro_scroll
functions.purpose: Main menu intro state: draws the background at scroll kaze_main_menu_state_timer (0..0x2a); any input (kaze_input_edge) or completion advances to select state kaze_main_menu_substate=1.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_select_input
functions.purpose: Main menu select input: idle timeout 0xe10 exits to attract (kaze_menu_screen_mode=8); dpad nav via tables kaze_main_menu_neighbor_up_table/238/248/258; Circle maps items 0..3 to menu modes 1/2/5/4; selection change arms the zoom animation via kaze_main_menu_panel_zoom_phase.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_draw
functions.purpose: Main menu draw pass: title bar, selected item panel zoom animation, item icon highlights, selected item label, then the menu background.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_titlebar_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the main-menu title-bar SPRT per buffer (0xa0x0x10 at (-0x50,-0x58), clut(0x390,0xf0)) plus DR_TPAGE at kaze_main_menu_titlebar_sprite/kaze_main_menu_titlebar_tpage.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_panel_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the four 128x128 POLY_FT4 menu item preview panels at kaze_main_menu_panel_polys (tpages 0x140+i*0x20, cluts 0x340+i*0x10).

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_icon_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the four 64x64 menu item icon SPRTs per buffer at kaze_main_menu_icon_sprites (screen corners (-0xa0/0x60, -0x78/0x38), clut(0x380,0xf0)) plus DR_TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_label_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the four menu item label SPRTs per buffer at kaze_main_menu_label_sprites (0xa0x0x10 at y 0x44, v0=-0x70+i*0x10, clut(0x390,0xf0)) plus DR_TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_titlebar_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the main-menu title-bar SPRT and its DR_TPAGE into the GsOT prim list (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_panel_zoom_anim
functions.purpose: Animates the selected item panel: phase kaze_main_menu_panel_zoom_phase 0x400..0xbff shrinks the previous item then grows the new one with rsin width and brightness ramps, else sorts the resting 128x120 quad via GsSortPoly.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_icon_highlight_draw
functions.purpose: Menu item icon highlight pass: the selected icon (kaze_main_menu_selected_item) pulses via rsin(kaze_main_menu_icon_pulse_phase), the others step back toward 0x80; AddPrims all four icons plus TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_main_menu_label_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the item label SPRT for selection sub (kaze_main_menu_label_sprites + buf*0x50 + sel*0x14) plus its DR_TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_loop
functions.purpose: Game setup menu loop (menu mode 1): VSync/GsOT loop over states kaze_title_menu_state (10 intro, 0xb memcard prompt, 1 stage row, 2 mode row via kaze_settings_mode_row_handler, 3/4 option rows, 5 BGM row, 6 confirm, 0x14) until 99; keeps BGM kaze_setup_menu_bgm_track_id playing each frame via kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_init
functions.purpose: Setup menu init: state kaze_title_menu_state=10, BGM 0xd, row defaults (kaze_menu_stage_source=1, kaze_menu_mode_source=1, kaze_menu_level_source/kaze_menu_flags_source/kaze_menu_weather_source=0), then runs the setup-screen primitive initializers.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_intro_scroll
functions.purpose: Setup menu intro state: draws the background at scroll kaze_setup_menu_scroll_counter (0..0x2a); returns 1 on input or completion so the loop advances to the memcard prompt state 0xb.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_memcard_prompt_state
functions.purpose: Setup menu memory-card prompt state: kaze_task_menu_state_machine result 1 enters the stage row (state 1); result 2 exits the setup menu (kaze_title_menu_state=99) back to the main menu (kaze_menu_screen_mode=0).

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_stage_row_input
functions.purpose: Setup menu stage-row input: Left/Right cycle kaze_menu_stage_source 0..2 (committed to staging kaze_staged_stage_index by kaze_settings_menu_dispatch); Circle advances to the mode row (state 2), Cross back to the prompt state 0xb.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_ack_input_2978
functions.purpose: Setup menu state-0x14 input: Circle or Cross returns to the mode row (kaze_title_menu_state=2) with a cancel sound.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_option_row_29b4
functions.purpose: Setup menu option-row input (state 3): Left/Right cycle kaze_menu_level_source 0..2 with arrow-flash bytes kaze_setup_row1_flash_level/kaze_setup_row2_flash_level; Down to state 4, Circle to confirm state 6, Cross back to mode row 2.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_option_row_2ad8
functions.purpose: Setup menu option-row input (state 4): Left/Right cycle kaze_menu_flags_source 0..3 (arrow flash kaze_setup_row1_flash_flags/kaze_setup_row2_flash_flags); Up to state 3, Down to BGM row 5, Circle to confirm 6, Cross back to mode row 2.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_bgm_row_input
functions.purpose: Setup menu BGM-row input (state 5): Left/Right cycle kaze_menu_weather_source 0..9 and map it to BGM id kaze_setup_menu_bgm_track_id (0xd default, else 0..8); Up to state 4, Circle to confirm 6, Cross back to mode row 2.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_confirm_input
functions.purpose: Setup menu confirm state (6): Circle exits and starts the game (kaze_title_menu_state=99, kaze_menu_screen_mode=9 so kaze_settings_menu_dispatch commits settings); Cross returns to option row state 3.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_mode_texture_upload
functions.purpose: Uploads the preview texture for the selected mode: kaze_tim_load_to_vram on (&kaze_menu_mode_preview_tim_table)[kaze_menu_mode_source], guarded by the change-latch bitmask kaze_setup_menu_mode_texture_latch.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_stage_row_draw
functions.purpose: Stage-row draw pass: highlight box at kaze_menu_stage_source*0x50+0x33, shared setup panels (kaze_title_cursor_frame_draw_3e00, kaze_title_panel_prims_add_3edc(0), kaze_title_rows3_highlight_draw), then the menu background.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_mode_row_draw
functions.purpose: Mode-row draw pass: shared panels, mode widgets kaze_settings_mode_rows_draw, highlight box at kaze_menu_mode_source*0x50+0x33, then the menu background.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_draw_2f88
functions.purpose: Setup menu state-0x14 draw wrapper; just calls kaze_title_bg_prims_add.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_option_rows_draw
functions.purpose: Option/confirm rows draw pass: highlight box at y 0x60/0x80/0xa0 per state kaze_title_menu_state (3/4/5), label variant to kaze_title_panel_prims_add_3edc, then kaze_title_row_groups_fade_draw/kaze_title_icon_rows_draw widgets and background.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_header_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits setup-menu header sprites per buffer at kaze_setup_menu_preview_sprite: a 64x64 preview SPRT at (-0xa0,-0x78) (clut 0x3c0) and a 128x32 caption SPRT at (-0x60,-0x58) (clut 0x3d0) with DR_TPAGEs.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_textline_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits six 256x16 setup-menu text-line SPRTs per buffer at kaze_setup_menu_textline_sprites (y 0x58, v0=i*16, clut(0x340,0xf1)) plus DR_TPAGE and two LINE_F3 underline frames.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_stage_panel_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the three 0x40x0x80 stage-choice panel SPRTs per buffer at kaze_setup_menu_stage_panel_sprites (x -0x70/-0x20/0x30, cluts 0x360+i*0x10); the choice selected by kaze_menu_stage_source gets brightness 0x80, others 0x40.

functions.name: kaze_setup_menu_mode_panel_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the three mode-choice panel SPRTs at kaze_setup_menu_mode_panel_sprites (uv from kaze_mode_panel_uv_u_table/kaze_mode_panel_uv_v_table tables, cluts 0x390+i*0x10, selected kaze_menu_mode_source bright) plus three 0x18x0x20 icon SPRTs (clut 0x3f0).

functions.name: kaze_title_menu_row_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds double-buffered title-menu SPRT rows (3/4/10 entries) at kaze_setup_menu_level_row_sprites/kaze_setup_menu_flags_row_sprites/kaze_setup_menu_weather_row_sprites with CLUTs from (0x350,0xf1) plus a DR_TPAGE per buffer.

functions.name: kaze_title_icon_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds two rows of 3 SPRT_16 icons per draw buffer at kaze_title_icon_row1_sprites/kaze_title_icon_row2_sprites (CLUT 0x3e0,0xf1, tpage 0x200) and resets their brightness bytes kaze_setup_row1_flash_level/kaze_setup_row2_flash_level.

functions.name: kaze_title_bg_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the fullscreen title background per buffer: 256x240 SPRT at kaze_title_bg_sprt_prims plus a second, unnamed 64x240 SPRT further into that block, with tpages 0x280/0x300 and CLUT (0x140,0xf0).

functions.name: kaze_title_cursor_frame_draw_3e00
functions.purpose: Positions the two-part title cursor/frame at (x-0xa0,y-0x78)/(x-0x60,y-0x58) and AddPrims 4 prims (kaze_setup_menu_preview_sprite/204/214/23c) into OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_title_panel_prims_add_3edc
functions.purpose: Adds a title-menu panel group (kaze_setup_menu_textline_underline_a/37c/33c) plus the row prim selected by the given row index (kaze_setup_menu_textline_sprites + row*0x14) into OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_title_rows3_highlight_draw
functions.purpose: Fades 3 menu-row sprites at kaze_setup_menu_stage_panel_sprites toward bright when row==kaze_menu_stage_source, dims others, then AddPrims the rows plus trailer prim kaze_setup_menu_stage_panel_tpage.

functions.name: kaze_settings_mode_rows_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the 3 settings rows keyed to cursor kaze_menu_mode_source; adds a marker prim per row when flag kaze_task_grid_available_flags[row + kaze_menu_stage_source*3] is set, using the same fade-highlight scheme.

functions.name: kaze_title_row_groups_fade_draw
functions.purpose: Fades the 3/4/10-entry title row groups toward selected tint based on title state kaze_title_menu_state (3..6), then adds the entries chosen by kaze_menu_level_source/kaze_menu_flags_source/kaze_menu_weather_source.

functions.name: kaze_title_icon_rows_draw
functions.purpose: Decays icon brightness bytes kaze_setup_row1_flash_level/kaze_setup_row2_flash_level toward 0x80, applies them to both SPRT_16 icon rows, and AddPrims them plus tpage prim kaze_title_icon_rows_tpage_prims.

functions.name: kaze_title_bg_prims_add
functions.purpose: Adds the title background SPRT/DR_TPAGE prims (kaze_title_bg_sprt_prims/914/8d8/91c) at the OT tail ((&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5]+0x3ffc) so they draw behind everything.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_screen_loop
functions.purpose: Modal loop for the 3x3 grid-select screen: GsClearOt/kaze_grid_select_state_step/GsDrawOt with VSync until state kaze_grid_select_state==99, then teardown kaze_grid_select_teardown; keeps sound tick kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0(0xd).
