functions.name: kaze_grid_select_init
functions.purpose: Allocates two 0x17c prim buffers into kaze_grid_select_prim_buffer_a/6c, clamps selection kaze_menu_variant_source from save byte kaze_grid_variant_saved_index, seeds state kaze_grid_select_state from kaze_grid_select_reentry_flag, and builds sprites.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_teardown
functions.purpose: Frees the two prim buffers and maps chosen slot kaze_menu_variant_source to title-menu row values kaze_menu_stage_source/kaze_menu_flags_source/kaze_menu_level_source/kaze_menu_weather_source via ROM tables kaze_variant_stage_source_table/2f.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_state_step
functions.purpose: Per-frame state machine for kaze_grid_select_state: 0 intro fade + dialog, 1 fade-in, 2 confirm dialog (kaze_task_menu_state_machine), 10 grid input kaze_grid_select_input, then draw kaze_grid_select_draw.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_fade_step
functions.purpose: Advances the screen fade counter kaze_grid_select_fade_counter to 0x2a via kaze_drmove_wipe_tiles; any new input kaze_input_edge skips it. Returns 1 when finished.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_confirm_result
functions.purpose: Routes the kaze_task_menu_state_machine dialog result: 1 enters grid state 10; 2 exits (kaze_grid_select_state=99) clearing kaze_menu_variant_source/kaze_grid_select_reentry_flag/kaze_menu_screen_mode.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_input
functions.purpose: D-pad navigation over the 3x3 slot grid kaze_menu_variant_source (enabled when kaze_grid_variant_saved_index==9); accept (0x20) exits with kaze_menu_screen_mode=9 and slot+1, cancel (0x40) returns to dialog state 2.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the selection ring at the current 3x3 cell (0x48/0x30 pitch), then frame prims kaze_grid_select_frame_prims_add, cell prims kaze_grid_select_pulse_draw, and fade overlay kaze_drmove_addprim_a0ec.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_frame_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds header/banner SPRTs plus DR_TPAGE inside each allocated buffer kaze_grid_select_prim_buffer_a/6c (CLUTs 0x360/0x370 row 0xf6, tpage 0x3c0).

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_cell_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds nine 0x28x0x28 cell SPRTs per buffer, recolors the first kaze_grid_variant_saved_index unlocked cells with CLUT (0x350,0xf6), and nine semi-transparent shadow TILEs.

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_frame_prims_add
functions.purpose: Positions the two header sprites of buffer idx at (x-0xa0,y-0x78)/(x-0x60,y-0x58) and adds them plus the DR_TPAGE to OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_grid_select_pulse_draw
functions.purpose: Pulses the selected cell tint with rsin phase kaze_grid_select_pulse_phase (color channel picked by kaze_grid_variant_saved_index tier), then AddPrims the 9 cell sprites and 9 shadow tiles.

functions.name: kaze_options_screen_loop
functions.purpose: Modal loop for the options/entry menu: GsClearOt/kaze_options_state_dispatch/GsDrawOt with VSync until kaze_options_state==99; sound tick kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0 uses 0xc during state 3, else 0xd.

functions.name: kaze_options_screen_init
functions.purpose: Resets options-menu state vars kaze_options_state..kaze_options_fade_reverse_flag and builds all sprite sets (kaze_registration_sprites_init_all registration, kaze_options_header_sprites_init/kaze_options_row_sprites_init headers+rows, kaze_button_config_sprites_init key config, kaze_sound_mode_sprites_init sound).

functions.name: kaze_options_state_dispatch
functions.purpose: State machine kaze_options_state: 0/1 top menu, 2/3 balloon registration (kaze_registration_state_dispatch), 4/5 button config, 6/7 sound mode, 10/0xb sub-screen kaze_records_screen_frame; fades via kaze_options_fade_step.

functions.name: kaze_options_fade_step
functions.purpose: Advances fade counter kaze_options_fade_counter to 0x2a via kaze_drmove_wipe_tiles (mode 3 while kaze_options_fade_reverse_flag set), input skips; clears kaze_options_fade_mode and returns 1 when done.

functions.name: kaze_options_top_menu_input
functions.purpose: Up/down over 4 rows kaze_options_top_menu_row; accept routes row 0 to state 10 (kaze_records_screen_init sub-screen), 1 to registration init kaze_registration_screen_init, 2 to button config, 3 to sound mode; cancel exits with kaze_menu_screen_mode=0.

functions.name: kaze_button_config_cursor_reset
functions.purpose: Zeroes the button-config cursor state kaze_button_config_action_row/958/95c/960 (action row, toggle row, column, exit-row flag).

functions.name: kaze_button_config_input
functions.purpose: Navigates the key-config grid: rows kaze_button_config_action_row (5 actions) / kaze_button_config_toggle_row (2 toggles), column kaze_button_config_column_flag, exit row kaze_button_config_remap_armed_flag; toggles kaze_settings_toggle_a flags and hands remap to kaze_button_remap_assign.

functions.name: kaze_button_remap_assign
functions.purpose: Assigns the pressed pad button (masks 0x20/0x80/0x10/0x40/4/1/8/2 mapped to action codes 0..7) into config slot (&kaze_button_action_map)[row], swapping conflicts via kaze_button_map_find_action/kaze_button_map_copy_slot.

functions.name: kaze_button_map_find_action
functions.purpose: Searches the 5-slot button-config array kaze_button_action_map for the given action code; returns the slot index or -1.

functions.name: kaze_button_map_copy_slot
functions.purpose: Copies the button-config value from slot arg0 to slot arg1 in kaze_button_action_map (conflict-swap helper for remapping).

functions.name: kaze_sound_mode_input
functions.purpose: Stereo/mono cursor kaze_sound_mode_cursor with immediate preview via kaze_xa_stream_enable_33b0/kaze_xa_stream_disable_33e8; accept (0x20) stores kaze_sound_mode_setting, cancel (0x40) restores the saved mode.

functions.name: kaze_options_top_menu_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the top options menu: cursor ring at row kaze_options_top_menu_row (0x18 pitch), header group 0 via kaze_options_header_prims_add, row labels kaze_options_rows_highlight_draw, and fade overlay.

functions.name: kaze_button_config_screen_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the key-config screen: computes the cursor ring rect from kaze_button_config_action_row/958/95c/960, header group 1, and all config prims via kaze_button_config_prims_draw.

functions.name: kaze_sound_mode_screen_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the sound-mode screen: cursor ring at kaze_sound_mode_cursor (0x20 pitch), header group 2, labels kaze_sound_mode_prims_add, fade overlay.

functions.name: kaze_options_header_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds 4 header banner sprite pairs per buffer at kaze_options_header_left_sprites/kaze_options_header_right_sprites with CLUT coords from ROM tables kaze_header_sprite_clut_x_table/kaze_header_sprite_clut_y_table, tpage (0x380,0x100).

functions.name: kaze_options_row_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the 4 top-menu row-label SPRTs per buffer at kaze_options_row_label_sprites (CLUT 0x350,0xf3, tpage 0x380) with neutral 0x80 tint.

functions.name: kaze_button_config_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds key-config sprites per buffer: 6 action labels at kaze_button_config_action_label_sprites, 5 button glyphs at UNK_800abc70 (CLUT 0x360,0xf2), and 2 toggle glyphs at UNK_800abd48 (CLUT 0x380,0xf3).

functions.name: kaze_sound_mode_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the 2 stereo/mono label SPRTs per buffer at kaze_sound_mode_label_sprites (CLUT 0x350,0xf3, tpage 0x380).

functions.name: kaze_options_header_set_y
functions.purpose: Sets the Y coordinates of the header banner sprite pair (kaze_options_header_left_sprites_y/kaze_options_header_right_sprites_y) for the given buffer/group; used by the editor zoom animation.

functions.name: kaze_options_header_prims_add
functions.purpose: Optionally resets the group header pair to default positions, then AddPrims the two header sprites plus DR_TPAGE kaze_options_header_tpage_prims into OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_options_rows_highlight_draw
functions.purpose: Fades the 4 top-menu row labels toward the selected tint for row kaze_options_top_menu_row and AddPrims them plus tpage prim kaze_options_row_label_tpage_prims.

functions.name: kaze_button_config_prims_draw
functions.purpose: Sets the 5 button-glyph UVs from mapping kaze_button_action_map and the 2 toggle glyph UVs from kaze_settings_toggle_a/1d, then AddPrims all key-config sprites/tpages.

functions.name: kaze_sound_mode_prims_add
functions.purpose: Adds the two stereo/mono label sprites and their DR_TPAGE for the given buffer to OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_registration_state_dispatch
functions.purpose: Dispatches the kaze_task_menu_state registration machine: 0 balloon select, 10 confirm, 0x14 paint editor, 0x15/0x16 zoom in/out, 0x1e RGB edit, 0x28/0x29/0x2b/0x2c task pages via kaze_task_carousel_frame_draw; on 99 restores kaze_task_record_index.

functions.name: kaze_registration_sprites_init_all
functions.purpose: Calls the six registration/balloon-editor sprite builders kaze_balloon_select_row_sprites_init, kaze_registration_confirm_sprites_init, kaze_balloon_editor_panel_sprites_init, kaze_color_edit_popup_sprites_init, kaze_paint_cursor_sprites_init, and kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprites_init.

functions.name: kaze_registration_screen_init
functions.purpose: Resets the kaze_task_menu_state state block, copies balloon model (&kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer)[kaze_task_record_index] (0x14a0 bytes) into the GPU buffer, links GsDOBJ2 kaze_menu_model1_gsobj, and sets view vars kaze_menu_camera_pos_x..

functions.name: kaze_balloon_select_input
functions.purpose: Up/down cycles balloon index kaze_task_record_index (0..4), recopying that model into the display buffer; accept (0x20) enters zoom state 0x15, cancel (0x40) exits 99 with kaze_task_menu_confirm_flag=1.

functions.name: kaze_registration_confirm_input
functions.purpose: Two-option confirm cursor kaze_registration_confirm_cursor; accept on row 0 enters zoom state 0x15, row 1 exits 99; cancel returns to balloon-select state 0.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_paint_input
functions.purpose: Paint editor input: held 0x20 paints RGB kaze_balloon_paint_color_r/48/4c into hovered poly (&kaze_model_prim_ptr_table)[kaze_balloon_paint_hovered_poly_idx]+4..6, 0x40 eyedrops it, 0x10 opens RGB edit (0x1e), 0x800 copies the model back and exits via 0x16.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_color_channel_edit
functions.purpose: RGB editor: up/down picks channel kaze_balloon_color_edit_channel (0..2); left/right adjusts (&kaze_balloon_color_edit_r)[ch] by 2 (8 after hold kaze_input_hold_timer>=0x11); accept commits to kaze_balloon_paint_color_r/48/4c, cancel back to 0x14.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_editor_zoom_in_anim
functions.purpose: 0x20-frame transition into the paint editor: slides label/panel sprite positions and camera kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8 by counter kaze_task_transition_counter, then sets state 0x14.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_editor_zoom_out_anim
functions.purpose: 0x20-frame reverse transition out of the paint editor; on completion promotes pending flags kaze_task_name_letter0_table[balloon*3+i] from -2 to -1, calls kaze_task_name_letter_models_link, and sets state 0x29.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_paint_cursor_move
functions.purpose: Moves the free paint cursor ((&kaze_balloon_paint_cursor_x/1fe)[buf*8]) with held d-pad kaze_input_current_c, step 1 (or 4 after hold timer kaze_input_hold_timer>=0x11), clamped to +/-0x90 x and +/-0x68 y.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_paint_poly_pick
functions.purpose: Picks the balloon polygon under the paint cursor: RotMatrix/GsGetLws setup, RotNclip3-projects up to 0x108 tris from vertex table kaze_model_vertex_ptr_table, point-in-triangle tests via ratan2/rsin; returns index or -1.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_paint_highlight_update
functions.purpose: Animates the rainbow LINE_F4 outline (kaze_balloon_paint_highlight_prims block) around the hovered poly using color phases kaze_balloon_highlight_phase_r/5c/60 (mod 0x60) into table kaze_balloon_color_shade_table and the projected vertices.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_view_rotate_input
functions.purpose: Paint-editor view control: buttons rotate model yaw kaze_menu_camera_rot_y / pitch kaze_menu_camera_rot_x in timed 0x10-frame steps and zoom camera kaze_menu_camera_scroll/e8 in 0x14-frame steps (direction parity kaze_balloon_view_zoom_dir_counter).

functions.name: kaze_balloon_select_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the balloon-select screen: cursor ring at row kaze_task_record_index, header group 3, list prims kaze_task_name_grid_draw/kaze_task_menu_row_sprites_draw, swing kaze_balloon_switch_swing_anim, spins model (kaze_menu_camera_rot_y+=8) and renders via kaze_title_model_sort_dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_registration_confirm_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the confirm dialog: cursor ring at kaze_registration_confirm_cursor, header group 3, prims kaze_menu_two_row_sprites_draw_a210, spins the balloon model and renders the 3D OT via kaze_title_model_sort_dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_paint_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the paint editor: panel prims kaze_menu_prim_pair_draw_a6a4/kaze_menu_panel_grid_draw_a308, hovered-poly highlight LINE_F4 (kaze_balloon_paint_highlight_prims) when kaze_balloon_paint_hovered_poly_idx!=-1, then 3D model via kaze_title_model_sort_primary.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_editor_zoom_in_draw
functions.purpose: Draw pass for zoom-in state 0x15: header group 3 without reposition, list prims kaze_task_name_grid_draw/kaze_task_menu_row_sprites_draw/kaze_menu_panel_grid_draw_a308 at animated positions, plus 3D model kaze_title_model_sort_primary.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_editor_zoom_out_draw
functions.purpose: Draw pass for zoom-out state 0x16: panel prims kaze_menu_panel_grid_draw_a308 plus the 3D balloon model via kaze_title_model_sort_primary and fade overlay.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_color_editor_draw
functions.purpose: Draw pass for RGB-edit state 0x1e: popup prims via kaze_menu_rgb_slider_panel_draw, then the 3D model kaze_title_model_sort_primary and fade overlay kaze_drmove_addprim_a0ec.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_switch_swing_anim
functions.purpose: During balloon switch (counter kaze_balloon_switch_anim_counter) swings camera yaw kaze_menu_camera_scroll with rcos, and at midpoint 0x10 copies the newly selected model into the display buffer and relinks GsDOBJ2 kaze_menu_model1_gsobj.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_select_row_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the 5 balloon-name row SPRTs per buffer at kaze_balloon_name_row_sprites (CLUT 0x340,0xf2, tpage 0x340); their X coords are animated by the editor zoom.

functions.name: kaze_registration_confirm_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the 2 confirm-option label SPRTs per buffer at kaze_registration_confirm_label_sprites (CLUT 0x340,0xf2) plus DR_TPAGE kaze_registration_confirm_tpage_prims.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_editor_panel_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the editor side panel: 8 semi-trans label SPRTs at kaze_balloon_editor_label_sprites (2 columns), current-color preview SPRT kaze_balloon_editor_preview_sprite (CLUT 0x390,0xf2), and color swatch TILE_16 kaze_balloon_editor_swatch_tiles.

functions.name: kaze_color_edit_popup_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the RGB-edit popup: 0xc0x0x48 semi-trans window SPRT kaze_color_edit_popup_window_sprite, 3 channel-label SPRT_16s at kaze_color_edit_channel_label_sprites (CLUT 0x3a0,0xf2), and a 9x0x25 cursor TILE kaze_color_edit_popup_cursor_tiles.

functions.name: kaze_paint_cursor_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds the paint-cursor SPRT_16 at kaze_balloon_paint_cursor_sprites (position words kaze_balloon_paint_cursor_x/1fe) and the LINE_F4 poly-highlight prim kaze_balloon_paint_highlight_prims per buffer.

functions.name: kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Builds a 5x3 SPRT_16 grid per buffer at kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprites (CLUT 0x370,0xf3, tpage 0x380); its positions (kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprite_x/7e) are laid out by the editor zoom-in animation.

functions.name: kaze_task_menu_row_sprites_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the 5 task-list row SPRTs at kaze_balloon_name_row_sprites (repositioned to x=-0x90, y=-0x1c step 0x18 when arg1) plus their DR_TPAGE into the menu OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_menu_two_row_sprites_draw_a210
functions.purpose: Draws a 2-row menu sprite column at kaze_registration_confirm_label_sprites (same x=-0x90/y step 0x18 layout as the task list) plus DR_TPAGE kaze_registration_confirm_tpage_prims into the menu OT.

functions.name: kaze_menu_panel_grid_draw_a308
functions.purpose: Draws an 8-sprite 2x4 menu panel grid at kaze_balloon_editor_label_sprites (x=(i/4)*0xe0-0x90, y=(i%4)*0x18+8), an RGB-tinted prim from kaze_balloon_paint_color_r..4c, and extra panel/TPAGE prims into the menu OT.

functions.name: kaze_menu_rgb_slider_panel_draw
functions.purpose: Draws a 3-slider adjust panel: handle x = kaze_balloon_color_edit_r[i]/2-0x4c, cursor box via kaze_linef3_gradient_bar at row kaze_balloon_color_edit_channel, and a preview prim whose r/g/b color bytes are copied from the three kaze_balloon_color_edit_r..52 values.

functions.name: kaze_menu_prim_pair_draw_a6a4
functions.purpose: Adds one menu panel prim (kaze_balloon_paint_cursor_sprites+buf*0x10) and its DR_TPAGE (kaze_balloon_paint_cursor_tpages) to the menu OT for the current buffer.

functions.name: kaze_task_name_grid_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the 5x3 task-name letter grid: reads 3-char codes per task from kaze_task_name_letter0_table, maps code to glyph UV ((c%8)*0x10-0x80,(c/8)*0x10-0x80) in SPRTs at kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprites, code 0xfe rendered as glyph 0x25; skips codes >= 0x27.

functions.name: kaze_task_glyph_models_link
functions.purpose: Maps the letter TMD at kaze_menu_task_model_ptr via GsMapModelingData, links its kaze_task_glyph_count glyph objects into GsDOBJ2 slots kaze_task_glyph_dobjs with GsCOORDINATE2s at kaze_task_glyph_coordinates, and zeroes the rotation table kaze_task_glyph_rotation_x.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_state_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the letter-carousel state: builds the 0x29-entry angle ring kaze_task_carousel_angle_ring (step kaze_task_carousel_angle_step=0x63e70), resets index/rotation vars kaze_task_carousel_visible_index/518/520/524/528/52c/530/538, clears rotation tables, calls kaze_task_carousel_constants_init.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_constants_init
functions.purpose: Sets the carousel camera/animation constants kaze_task_carousel_transition_amplitude..kaze_task_letter_delete_phase2_amplitude (lift amplitude, letter fly-in offsets, easing divisors) used by the letter add/delete animations.

functions.name: kaze_task_name_letter_models_link
functions.purpose: Links up to 3 letter models for the current task name (chars kaze_task_name_letter0_table[kaze_task_record_index*3]) into GsDOBJ2 slots kaze_task_name_letter_dobjs with coords kaze_task_name_letter_coordinates, positioned x=-0x140/0/0x140, y=-0x260, z=-0x800.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_intro_anim
functions.purpose: Carousel intro/zoom transition: ramps camera fields kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8 and view via kaze_gs_view_set_pose_94c8 over 0x40 frames of kaze_task_transition_counter, drops ring glyphs into place from rsin/rcos of kaze_task_carousel_angle_ring, ramps flat light/ambient, then sets task-menu state kaze_task_menu_state=0x28.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_update
functions.purpose: Per-frame letter-carousel update dispatcher: rotate input, rotation interp, ring layout, confirm input, add-letter anim, delete input, delete anim, and camera bob (kaze_task_carousel_rotate_input/b628/c4c4/b7b0/b898/bc94/bd68/c6c0).

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_exit_update
functions.purpose: Exit-state (0x2b) update pair: runs the nested carousel exit handler kaze_task_carousel_exit_handler and the camera-descend step kaze_task_menu_camera_descend.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_autospin_step
functions.purpose: State-0x2c auto-spin: steps ring base kaze_task_carousel_visible_index and position counter kaze_task_carousel_selected_index in direction kaze_task_carousel_direction, rebuilds the angle ring; at count 0x28 sets menu state kaze_task_menu_state and kaze_task_carousel_input_index=1, ticking sound 0x78 every 3 steps.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_rotate_input
functions.purpose: Carousel left/right input: press mask kaze_input_edge and held mask kaze_input_current_c with repeat timer kaze_input_hold_timer move target kaze_task_carousel_input_index; computes shortest signed delta to kaze_task_carousel_visible_index and starts rotation (dir kaze_task_carousel_direction, steps kaze_task_carousel_transition_duration/52c) with sound 0x78.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_rotate_interp
functions.purpose: Rotation interpolator: while countdown kaze_task_carousel_transition_ticks is active, rebuilds the kaze_task_carousel_angle_ring angle ring from base index and adds a fractional per-frame rotation offset in the current direction; clears kaze_task_carousel_previous_index when done.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_select_input
functions.purpose: Circle-press select on the carousel: slot 0x27 arms letter delete (kaze_task_letter_delete_arm_timer=0x18, snd 0x79), slot 0x28 ends entry (state 0x2b + scatter init kaze_task_carousel_scatter_init, snd 2), otherwise arms add-letter anim (kaze_task_carousel_exit_timer=0x1e, snd 0x7a) when fewer than 3 letters.

functions.name: kaze_task_letter_add_anim_commit
functions.purpose: Add-letter animation/commit: eases the selected glyph toward the name row with rsin (constants kaze_task_letter_add_spin_amplitude/544/550) and spins it; on completion links a new letter model, stores the glyph code into kaze_task_name_letter0_table[slot+task*3], and at 3 letters sets state 0x2c.

functions.name: kaze_task_letter_delete_input
functions.purpose: Cross-press delete-letter input: first press arms kaze_task_letter_delete_arm_timer=0x18 with sound 0x79; pressing again immediately clears the last name char to 0xff and decrements the letter count kaze_task_letter_count.

functions.name: kaze_task_letter_delete_anim
functions.purpose: Delete-letter animation: kaze_task_letter_delete_arm_timer countdown eases the last letter model up then away with rsin (constants kaze_task_letter_delete_phase1_divisor/560/564/568) and per-slot drift, then clears the char in kaze_task_name_letter0_table to 0xff and decrements kaze_task_letter_count.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_scatter_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the carousel dismiss scatter: per glyph picks random targets via kaze_rand_range and precomputes per-frame step deltas (over 0x28 frames) into kaze_task_carousel_scatter_frame_count/kaze_task_carousel_scatter_target_x/kaze_task_carousel_scatter_target_y/kaze_task_carousel_scatter_step_mag/kaze_task_carousel_scatter_remaining/kaze_task_carousel_scatter_step_x/kaze_task_carousel_scatter_step_y.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_layout_update
functions.purpose: Recomputes glyph ring positions from the kaze_task_carousel_angle_ring angles (radius 0x600 rsin/rcos into kaze_task_carousel_glyph_pos_x/98), lifting the selected kaze_task_carousel_selected_index (rcos) and previous kaze_task_carousel_previous_index (rsin) by rotation-phase bump kaze_task_carousel_transition_amplitude.

functions.name: kaze_task_menu_camera_bob
functions.purpose: Idle task-menu camera motion: spins yaw kaze_menu_camera_rot_y by 8/frame and bobs camera height kaze_menu_camera_scroll with rsin of phase kaze_task_menu_camera_bob_phase.

functions.name: kaze_task_menu_camera_descend
functions.purpose: Exit-state camera step: keeps yaw kaze_menu_camera_rot_y spinning while lowering camera height kaze_menu_camera_scroll by 0x10 per frame.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_frame_draw
functions.purpose: Task-carousel frame draw: sets base color (kaze_gs_light_set_color_9568), clears the buffer OT (kaze_title_model_sort_dispatch), renders ring glyphs (kaze_task_carousel_glyph_render) and entered letters (kaze_task_name_letters_render), then finishes with kaze_drmove_addprim_a0ec.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_glyph_render
functions.purpose: Renders the carousel glyph 3D objects when kaze_task_menu_state is 0x28/0x29/0x2b/0x2c: culls by ring angle window, applies highlight colors (kaze_task_carousel_glyph_highlight/cc60), RotMatrix+translate, GsGetLws, GsSortObject4 into the buffer OT.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_glyph_highlight
functions.purpose: Computes the highlight color ramp for the selected (kaze_task_carousel_selected_index) and previous (kaze_task_carousel_previous_index) glyphs, interpolating toward/away from the 0xe0 highlight over rotation progress kaze_task_carousel_transition_ticks/kaze_task_carousel_transition_duration, via color setter kaze_gs_light_set_color_9568.

functions.name: kaze_task_letter_add_highlight
functions.purpose: During the add-letter animation (kaze_task_carousel_exit_timer) ramps the selected glyph color from highlight toward red as the letter flies to the name row.

functions.name: kaze_task_name_letters_render
functions.purpose: Renders up to 3 entered task-name letter models (GsDOBJ2s kaze_task_name_letter_dobjs, rotations kaze_task_name_letter_rotation_x, positions kaze_task_name_letter_pos_x) with RotMatrix/GsGetLws/GsSortObject4 in red (0xe0,0,0).

functions.name: kaze_task_menu_prim_init
functions.purpose: Task-menu primitive init wrapper: kaze_balloon_select_row_sprites_init builds the 5 task-row SPRTs/TPAGEs at kaze_balloon_name_row_sprites and kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprites_init builds the 5x3 name letter-grid SPRT_16s at kaze_balloon_entry_grid_sprites.

functions.name: kaze_task_menu_enter_init
functions.purpose: Task-menu entry init: copies the current task's 0x14a0-byte model block from (&kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer)[kaze_task_record_index] to *(kaze_menu_model1_data_ptr+0x10), links GsDOBJ2 kaze_menu_model1_gsobj, resets state kaze_task_menu_state=0 and camera fields kaze_menu_camera_pos_x.., then kaze_gs_light_init_alt_9454 + carousel state init.

functions.name: kaze_task_menu_state_machine
functions.purpose: Task-menu master state machine on kaze_task_menu_state: 0 list, 2 slide-out, 0x28 carousel, 0x29 zoom, 0x2b exit anim, 0x2c auto-spin; draws the 3D frame, and at state 99 returns 1 (cancel, fade kaze_gs_view_set_pose_94c8) or 2 (task chosen, restores kaze_task_record_index=kaze_task_menu_confirmed_index).

functions.name: kaze_task_name_empty_check
functions.purpose: At state 0x15 checks the selected task's 3-char name at kaze_task_name_letter0_table+kaze_task_record_index*3: all 0xfe (empty) goes to state 2 (name entry), otherwise state 99 (accept/exit).

functions.name: kaze_task_list_slide_out_anim
functions.purpose: State-2 transition: slides the task-row and letter-grid sprites off-screen over 0x20 frames of kaze_task_transition_counter, then sets state 0x29, links the name letter models (kaze_task_name_letter_models_link), lays out ring glyph x/z, and converts 0xfe name chars to 0xff.

functions.name: kaze_task_carousel_zoom_anim
functions.purpose: State-0x29 zoom-in: ramps camera kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8 and view kaze_gs_view_set_pose_94c8 over 0x40 frames, lowers glyphs vertically into the ring, ramps flat light kaze_gs_light0_dir_x and ambient, then enters carousel state 0x28.

functions.name: kaze_task_list_draw
functions.purpose: State-0 task-list draw: cursor box via kaze_linef3_gradient_bar at row kaze_task_record_index, background page via kaze_title_cursor_frame_draw_3e00/kaze_grid_select_frame_prims_add, name grid kaze_task_name_grid_draw(,1) and row sprites kaze_task_menu_row_sprites_draw(,1), kaze_balloon_switch_swing_anim, yaw spin, OT clear + finish.

functions.name: kaze_task_list_slide_draw
functions.purpose: State-2 draw variant of the task list: passes vertical slide offset kaze_task_transition_counter*-2 to the background draw (kaze_title_cursor_frame_draw_3e00/kaze_grid_select_frame_prims_add) and draws grid/rows without repositioning while the slide-out animation runs.

functions.name: kaze_records_screen_frame
functions.purpose: Records-screen frame driver: at state kaze_records_screen_state==10 runs cursor input kaze_records_cursor_input (unless disabled) and draw kaze_records_draw_dispatch; returns true at state 99 after freeing the prim buffers (kaze_records_screen_free).

functions.name: kaze_records_screen_init
functions.purpose: Records screen init: allocates two 0x628 prim buffers kaze_records_screen_prim_buffer_a/kaze_records_screen_prim_buffer_b, copies the 3x3x6 record table kaze_record_table_a into working buffer kaze_records_working_table with a source-stage tag byte, resets cursor state (kaze_records_screen_state=10), builds prims.

functions.name: kaze_records_screen_free
functions.purpose: Frees the two records-screen prim buffers kaze_records_screen_prim_buffer_a/kaze_records_screen_prim_buffer_b via heap free kaze_heap_free.

functions.name: kaze_records_cursor_input
functions.purpose: Records cursor input from kaze_input_edge: Down/Up move category row kaze_records_cursor_row (0..2), Right/Left move stage tab kaze_records_cursor_tab (0..3) with slide timers; any d-pad on tab 3 re-sorts the combined table (kaze_records_combined_sort); Cross exits (state 99). Sounds 0x68/0x65.

functions.name: kaze_records_draw_dispatch
functions.purpose: Records draw dispatcher: ticks the roll-in timer kaze_records_cursor_move_timer then runs entry glyph update kaze_records_entry_glyph_update, header kaze_records_header_draw, rank labels kaze_records_rank_labels_draw, entries kaze_records_entries_draw, cursor/tabs kaze_records_cursor_tab_draw, and kaze_drmove_addprim_a0ec.

functions.name: kaze_records_entry_glyph_update
functions.purpose: Updates glyph UVs for the 6 visible record entries: 3-char name glyphs plus the value from kaze_record_table_score/kaze_records_working_table_score formatted per category row (row0/1 hundreds+fraction digits via kaze_uint_to_decimal_string, row2 mm:ss capped 99:59).

functions.name: kaze_records_header_prim_init
functions.purpose: One-time init of the records-screen header SPRTs and DR_TPAGE inside both kaze_records_screen_prim_buffer_a prim buffers (CLUTs at 0x390/0x3a0 x 0xf5, TPage 0x2c0).

functions.name: kaze_records_tab_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the records tab/label prims in both buffers: 4 stage-tab SPRTs (+0x4c), 3 category-row SPRTs (+0xa4), a semi-trans cursor TILE (+0xe8), and 4 underline TILEs (+0x220) sized from the entries in kaze_records_tab_underline_w_table and kaze_records_tab_underline_h_table.

functions.name: kaze_records_rank_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits 3 columns x 6 rows of SPRT_16 rank/label sprites (+0xf8/+0x158/+0x1b8) in both records buffers with CLUTs 0x3e0/0x3b0/0x3c0 and a DR_TPAGE.

functions.name: kaze_records_text_prim_init
functions.purpose: Inits the 6 rows x 8 entry-text SPRTs (+0x260, 8x16 glyph cells, CLUT 0x3d0, name chars then value digits) plus the final DR_TPAGE in both records buffers.

functions.name: kaze_records_header_draw
functions.purpose: AddPrims the three records-screen header prims (+0x0/+0x14/+0x28 of the buffer) to the OT (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_records_cursor_tab_draw
functions.purpose: Animates the records cursor cell slide (rsin easing on timers kaze_records_tab_slide_timer/9c with directions kaze_records_tab_slide_dir/94), positions the cursor tile, stage tabs and category labels relative to selection kaze_records_cursor_tab/adea8, and AddPrims them.

functions.name: kaze_records_rank_labels_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the rank-number and label SPRT_16 columns with roll-in y offsets from timer kaze_records_cursor_move_timer; on the combined tab (kaze_records_cursor_tab==3) tints each entry by its source-stage tag byte kaze_records_working_table_stage_tag.

functions.name: kaze_records_entries_draw
functions.purpose: Draws the 6 rows x 8 record entry text SPRTs with the same roll-in y-offset animation, then the text DR_TPAGE (+0x620).

functions.name: kaze_records_combined_sort
functions.purpose: Selection-sorts the merged 18-entry (3 stages x 6) working record buffer kaze_records_working_table/kaze_records_working_table_score for category row cat_arg - descending for category 1, ascending otherwise - used by the combined tab.

functions.name: kaze_record_table_insert
functions.purpose: Inserts a flight result into the persistent record table for stage/category: ranks value in the 6-entry kaze_record_table_score list (desc for category 1), shifts lower entries, stores the current task's 3-char name (kaze_task_name_letter0_table) and value, flags 1st place in kaze_task_grid_available_flags; skipped when kaze_staged_stage_variant scripted-start is set.

functions.name: kaze_record_table_reset_defaults
functions.purpose: Resets the 3x3x6 record table kaze_record_table_a/kaze_record_table_score from the ROM default table at kaze_record_default_initial0_table (name chars + value per entry).

functions.name: kaze_memcard_screen_loop
functions.purpose: Memory-card screen main loop: init kaze_memcard_screen_init, per-frame packet area/OT clear/state draw (kaze_memcard_state_dispatch) until kaze_memory_card_prompt_latch==99; busy states service card slots (kaze_memcard_slot_poll_start/b2e4/bde4/b56c, alternating kaze_memcard_active_slot_index) instead of input; frees kaze_memcard_work_buffer and runs kaze_xa_stream_enable_33b0/3e8 per kaze_sound_mode_setting.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_screen_init
functions.purpose: Memcard screen init: allocates the 0x2000 work buffer kaze_memcard_work_buffer (file image at +0x200), resets state kaze_memory_card_prompt_latch/070/074/078 and sets an unnamed memcard-status flag (between kaze_memcard_status_retry_count and kaze_memcard_slot_poll_counter) to 1, then builds screen prims via kaze_slot_overlay_header_sprites_init/61f78/620b4/62270.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_busy_state_check
functions.purpose: Returns 1 when the memcard screen state kaze_memory_card_prompt_latch is 10 or 0xc, i.e. frames that must service memory-card events instead of polling controller input.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_state_dispatch
functions.purpose: Memcard screen per-state update+draw dispatcher on kaze_memory_card_prompt_latch: 0 intro scroll, 1 save/load menu, 10 slot select, 0xb format flow, 0xc card recheck, 0x14 load flow, 0x1e save flow, each paired with its draw function.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_intro_scroll
functions.purpose: Intro scroll state: advances counter kaze_memcard_intro_scroll_timer to 0x2a while drawing the sliding panel via kaze_drmove_wipe_tiles, then enters menu state 1 (or immediately on any button).

functions.name: kaze_memcard_menu_select
functions.purpose: Save/load row select: Up/Down toggles row kaze_memcard_menu_row (snd 1); Circle enters slot select (state 10, resets kaze_memcard_slot_poll_counter/kaze_memcard_active_slot_index, card status reset kaze_memcard_slot_status_reset, snd 0x88); Cross exits (state 99, clears kaze_menu_screen_mode, snd 0x65).

functions.name: kaze_memcard_slot_status_reset
functions.purpose: Resets both card-slot status words (kaze_memcard_slot_request_state/154c=0x11 request flags, kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags/0e7c=0) and calls _card_wait(0) and _card_wait(1).

functions.name: kaze_memcard_slot_select
functions.purpose: Card-slot select state: watches slot status kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags/7c, Left/Right pick slot kaze_memcard_slot_index; Circle routes to format prompt (0xb) on unformatted flag 2, recheck (0xc) on flag 0x100, else load (0x14) or save (0x1e) per row kaze_memcard_menu_row; Cross returns to menu.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_format_flow
functions.purpose: Format flow state machine (phases kaze_memcard_format_phase): Circle confirm, card test kaze_memcard_probe_blocking then format kaze_memcard_format with up to 5 retries (kaze_memcard_status_retry_count); success proceeds to load/save state, failure phases return to the menu.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_load_flow
functions.purpose: Load flow (state 0x14, phases kaze_memory_card_load_state): confirm, card check kaze_memcard_probe_blocking, locate file BISLPS-00912 (kaze_memcard_file_count/bb58), read via kaze_memcard_file_read into kaze_memcard_work_buffer and apply via kaze_save_verify_unpack_full with up to 3 retries; no-file/error phases exit to menu.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_save_flow
functions.purpose: Save flow (state 0x1e, phases kaze_memory_card_save_state): checks free blocks kaze_memcard_free_blocks and existing BISLPS-00912 file (overwrite confirm), builds the save image via kaze_save_image_pack, writes with kaze_memcard_file_write; success/no-space/write-failed phases handle retry/exit.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_card_recheck
functions.purpose: Card recheck state (0xc): when slot status kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags clears, routes to format/load/save; while flag 0x100 persists re-arms status requests in kaze_memcard_slot_request_state up to 5 tries (kaze_memcard_status_retry_count), then allows Circle/Cross to return to the menu.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_menu_draw
functions.purpose: Draw for intro/menu states: cursor box via kaze_linef3_gradient_bar at row kaze_memcard_menu_row (y=row*0x20+0x5f), panel prims kaze_slot_overlay_add_header_prims/kaze_slot_overlay_add_glyph_prims, finish kaze_drmove_addprim_a0ec.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_slot_select_draw
functions.purpose: Slot-select draw: panels kaze_slot_overlay_add_header_prims/kaze_slot_overlay_add_rows, then picks a message id from card status words kaze_memcard_slot_request_state/154c and kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags/7c (checking 8, no card 9, select prompt 0/1) rendered via kaze_slot_overlay_add_status_strip.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_format_draw
functions.purpose: Format-flow draw: message id per phase kaze_memcard_format_phase (1 confirm, 8 busy, 10 formatted-ok, 5 failed, 0 no card) rendered via kaze_slot_overlay_add_status_strip with confirm-cursor flag.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_load_draw
functions.purpose: Load-flow draw: message id per phase kaze_memory_card_load_state (0xb confirm, 8 busy, 10 done, 6 no save file, 7 retry confirm, 0xe read error, 0 no card) via kaze_slot_overlay_add_status_strip.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_save_draw
functions.purpose: Save-flow draw: message id per phase kaze_memory_card_save_state (0xc confirm, 8 busy, 3 overwrite confirm, 10 saved-ok, 0xd no space, 4 write failed, 0 no card) via kaze_slot_overlay_add_status_strip.

functions.name: kaze_slot_select_overlay_draw
functions.purpose: Per-frame draw of the two-slot select overlay: adds header prims (kaze_slot_overlay_add_header_prims), the two rows with highlight at index kaze_memcard_slot_index and status flags kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags, and a status strip chosen by kaze_memcard_slot_request_state[sel] bit 2.

functions.name: kaze_save_verify_unpack_full
functions.purpose: Verifies the 0x1dfc-byte checksum of the save image at kaze_memcard_file_image, then unpacks options (kaze_task_record_index/dc14/dc1c/dc1d), five record tables into kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer[], the 3x3x6 grid at kaze_record_table_a, and bit flags to kaze_task_grid_available_flags.

functions.name: kaze_save_image_pack
functions.purpose: Builds the memcard save image at kaze_memcard_work_buffer: 'SC' header+title strcpy, icon data from kaze_save_icon_frame0/kaze_save_icon_frame1 (variant by kaze_rand_range()==0x32), packs options/records (kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer, kaze_record_table_a) and writes checksum at +0x1dfc.

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_header_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the double-buffered header SPRT pairs at kaze_slot_overlay_header_icon_sprites/kaze_slot_overlay_header_bar_sprites (CLUTs 0x340/0x370 at y 0xf4) plus DR_TPAGE prims at kaze_slot_overlay_header_tpages for the slot-select overlay.

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_glyph_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Initializes 2x2 double-buffered glyph SPRTs at kaze_slot_overlay_glyph_sprites (16px tall strips, CLUT 0x380, v stepping by 0x10) plus DR_TPAGE prims at kaze_slot_overlay_glyph_tpages for the slot-select overlay.

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_row_sprites_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the two selectable row sprite pairs at kaze_slot_overlay_row_icon_sprites/kaze_slot_overlay_row_highlight_sprites (CLUTs 0x360/0x350, x from -0x60 stepping 0x80) plus DR_TPAGE at kaze_slot_overlay_row_tpage_prims for the slot-select overlay.

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_panel_prims_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the status panel prims: SPRT at kaze_slot_overlay_status_sprites (CLUT 0x390), two DR_TPAGEs (0x240/0x280 pages), a TILE at kaze_slot_overlay_status_tile_prims, and LINE_F3 border lines at kaze_slot_overlay_status_border_light/kaze_slot_overlay_status_border_dark.

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_add_header_prims
functions.purpose: Adds the header SPRT pair (kaze_slot_overlay_header_icon_sprites/kaze_slot_overlay_header_bar_sprites) and their DR_TPAGE (kaze_slot_overlay_header_tpages) to the frame's ordering table (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_add_glyph_prims
functions.purpose: Adds the two glyph SPRTs at kaze_slot_overlay_glyph_sprites and their DR_TPAGE at kaze_slot_overlay_glyph_tpages to the ordering table (&kaze_menu_gs_ot_buf0_org)[buf*5].

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_add_rows
functions.purpose: Adds the two row sprite pairs (kaze_slot_overlay_row_icon_sprites/kaze_slot_overlay_row_highlight_sprites); dims rows whose kaze_memcard_slot_status_flags flags lack bits 1/2/0x100 and pulses brightness of the row selected by kaze_memcard_slot_index, plus DR_TPAGE kaze_slot_overlay_row_tpage_prims.

functions.name: kaze_slot_overlay_add_status_strip
functions.purpose: Adds the status strip SPRT kaze_slot_overlay_status_sprites with message glyph byte from the kaze_status_strip_glyph_table table (index 2 or 8), picks DR_TPAGE kaze_slot_overlay_status_tpage_lo/240 by index, and adds TILE/LINE_F3 frame prims.

functions.name: kaze_memcard_load_records
functions.purpose: Memcard load: allocs a 0x2000 buffer (kaze_memcard_work_buffer, data at +0x200), scans both card ports for file 'BISLPS-00912' (kaze_memcard_probe_blocking/kaze_memcard_file_count/kaze_memcard_find_file), reads it and verifies/unpacks records via kaze_save_verify_unpack_records.

functions.name: kaze_save_verify_unpack_records
functions.purpose: Verifies the 0x1dfc-byte checksum of the save image at kaze_memcard_file_image and unpacks only the five 0x108-entry record tables into the kaze_save_slot_unpack_buffer[] structures (stride 0x14) plus kaze_task_record_index.

functions.name: kaze_pad_edge_latch_update
functions.purpose: Pad edge/latch update: after kaze_pad_mask_update, copies current masks kaze_input_current_a/0e98 to kaze_menu_input_replay_flags/0ea4 and kaze_input_pad1_mask_previous/1540, derives new-press masks kaze_pad1_edge_mask/4d54 vs previous kaze_input_current_b/1514, and hold counters kaze_input_pad1_hold_counter/0f54.

functions.name: kaze_ending_screen_loop
functions.purpose: Ending/credits screen main loop: inits via kaze_ending_graphics_init/kaze_ending_state_reset, then per frame sets GS work base, clears/draws the OT (GsClearOt/GsSortClear/GsDrawOt), dispatches kaze_ending_state_dispatch until kaze_ending_screen_state==2; plays music kaze_ending_music_track_id via kaze_xa_audio_manager_35a0.

functions.name: kaze_ending_state_dispatch
functions.purpose: Ending screen state dispatcher on kaze_ending_screen_state: state 0 runs the debug viewer kaze_ending_debug_viewer_update, state 1 runs the credits sequence kaze_ending_credits_update.

functions.name: kaze_ending_credits_update
functions.purpose: Credits sequence driver on substate kaze_ending_credits_substate: loads END textures/balloon model (kaze_ending_textures_load/kaze_ending_balloon_model_load), per-page keyframe/credit setup (kaze_ending_credit_text_layout/kaze_ending_keyframe_load), fade and flame updates; exits to kaze_ending_screen_state=2 on pad bits 0x820 of kaze_pad1_edge_mask.

functions.name: kaze_ending_fade_poly_update
functions.purpose: Fade in/out for the ending screen: adds the POLY_F4 at kaze_ending_fade_polys plus DR_TPAGE kaze_ending_fade_tpage_prims and ramps level kaze_ending_fade_level by +/-5, switching phase flag kaze_ending_fade_phase at 0/0xff.

functions.name: kaze_ending_graphics_init
functions.purpose: Ending screen graphics init: ResetGraph/GsInitGraph(320x240)/GsInit3D, allocates two 24000-byte packet buffers (kaze_ending_packet_buffer_a/334) and two 0x1000-entry OTs (kaze_ending_ot_buffer_a/32c), then camera (kaze_ending_camera_init) and lighting (kaze_ending_lighting_init) init.

functions.name: kaze_ending_buffers_free
functions.purpose: Frees the ending screen's packet/OT buffers (kaze_ending_packet_buffer_a/334/328/32c) and texture/model allocations kaze_ending_asset_load_buffer_ptr/754 via kaze_heap_free, then kaze_xa_audio_stop_33a3c cleanup.

functions.name: kaze_ending_balloon_model_load
functions.purpose: Loads the balloon model 'BAL\\T\\BALL.MDL' into kaze_ending_balloon_model_ptr via kaze_file_load_by_name and links its TMD/texture sections through kaze_gs_model_pair_link_init_9604 for the ending flythrough.

functions.name: kaze_ending_textures_load
functions.purpose: Loads 'BAL\\T\\END.TXP' and uploads each TIM to VRAM (kaze_tim_load_to_vram), then loads 'BAL\\T\\END2.TXP' and fills the credit-page pointer table kaze_ending_credit_page_texture_table with its sub-image offsets.

functions.name: kaze_ending_prims_init
functions.purpose: Builds the ending scene prims: DR_MOVE screen-copy blocks at kaze_ending_screen_move_prims, backdrop SPRT/DR_TPAGE pairs, POLY_F4 kaze_ending_backdrop_poly, credit-logo and text SPRTs (CLUT 0x3c0), the semi-trans flame POLY_FT4 at kaze_ending_flame_polys, and GsInitCoordinate2.

functions.name: kaze_ending_fade_prims_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the double-buffered fade prims: semi-trans black POLY_F4 quads at kaze_ending_fade_polys covering the screen and DR_TPAGE prims at kaze_ending_fade_tpage_prims with blend mode from abr.

functions.name: kaze_ending_state_reset
functions.purpose: Resets the ending module state (kaze_ending_screen_state=1, fade 0xff, counters/pages zeroed, music id -2), uploads 'BAL\\T\\FULL.TIM' to VRAM at x=0x140, then builds prims via kaze_ending_prims_init/kaze_ending_fade_prims_init.

functions.name: kaze_ending_camera_init
functions.purpose: Initializes the ending camera: zeroes angle/pos vectors kaze_ending_camera_angle_x/3b4/3c4 (z=-0xbb8), GsInitCoordinate2 on kaze_ending_coord2_buffer, copies the GsVIEW2 template from kaze_gs_view2_template and calls GsSetView2 plus projection 0x180 via kaze_gs_set_projection.

functions.name: kaze_ending_lighting_init
functions.purpose: Sets up ending scene lighting: flat light 0 at kaze_ending_light0_dir_x (dir 0,1000,1000, white), zeroed light 1 at kaze_ending_light1_pos_x, GsSetAmbient(0x400) and GsSetLightMode(0).

functions.name: kaze_ending_burner_light_update
functions.purpose: Burner flame effect during the ending: on pad bit 0x10 of kaze_menu_input_replay_flags ramps kaze_ending_scene_transition_counter and flickers light 1 color/position (light follows balloon kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8) and flame quad verts kaze_ending_flame_quad_v0_x..; decays when released.

functions.name: kaze_ending_flame_quad_render
functions.purpose: Renders the burner flame POLY_FT4: positions its coordinate at balloon pos (Y+0x1d6), builds light/screen matrices via GsGetLws, RotAverageNclip4 transforms the quad kaze_ending_flame_quad_v0_x.. and AddPrims it at the computed OT depth.

functions.name: kaze_ending_credit_page_upload
functions.purpose: Uploads the current credit page texture (&kaze_ending_credit_page_texture_table)[kaze_ending_credit_page_index] to VRAM at (0x140,0x100) via kaze_tim_load_to_vram.

functions.name: kaze_ending_screen_move_prim_add
functions.purpose: Adds one DR_MOVE screen-copy prim from kaze_ending_screen_move_prims (selected by buffer and arg1) at the far end (+0x3ffc) of the ending OT.

functions.name: kaze_ending_credit_prims_add
functions.purpose: Adds credit-page prims: backdrop SPRT kaze_ending_backdrop_sprites at scroll pos kaze_ending_backdrop_scroll_x/408, then logo sprites and text-line sprites per the page's logo and text-line counts, read from each kaze_ending_path_keyframe_table record (stride 0x1c, the text-line count 0xc bytes into the record), plus POLY_F4 kaze_ending_backdrop_poly.

functions.name: kaze_ending_path_segment_setup
functions.purpose: Sets up a balloon flythrough segment: start kaze_ending_path_start_x.. into kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8, computes per-axis deltas/step signs (kaze_ending_path_delta_x..73c, speed kaze_ending_path_speed) and dominant axis selector kaze_ending_path_dominant_axis for the DDA stepper.

functions.name: kaze_ending_balloon_path_step
functions.purpose: DDA step of the ending balloon along the current segment: advances kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8 by the dominant-axis error accumulators (kaze_ending_path_error_x/72c/730) plus an rcos bobbing offset kaze_ending_balloon_bob_offset_y on Y; clears kaze_menu_camera_coord_flags.

functions.name: kaze_ending_keyframe_load
functions.purpose: Loads ending keyframe kaze_ending_credit_page_index from the 0x48-stride table at kaze_ending_keyframe_table: segment start/end positions, camera angles/pos, light vector/color, ambient and speed; rebuilds camera matrices and calls GsSetAmbient/GsSetFlatLight/GsSetView2.

functions.name: kaze_ending_credit_text_layout
functions.purpose: Lays out credit text for page kaze_ending_credit_page_index: centers title sprites and per-line glyph sprites using widths/UVs from the kaze_ending_text_glyph_width_table glyph table and line indices from the kaze_ending_path_keyframe_table page table (CLUT row from entry field +0x10).

functions.name: kaze_ending_debug_camera_control
functions.purpose: Hidden ending viewer control: select (bit 0x100 of kaze_pad1_edge_mask) cycles mode kaze_ending_debug_camera_mode; modes adjust camera angles/pos (kaze_ending_camera_angle_x/3b4), balloon pos kaze_menu_camera_pos_x.., or light vector/color kaze_ending_light0_dir_x.. from pad mask kaze_menu_input_replay_flags.

functions.name: kaze_ending_camera_reset_defaults
functions.purpose: Resets the ending viewer camera/light to defaults: camera at z=-0xbb8 with zero angles, balloon pos kaze_menu_camera_pos_x/e4/e8 and kaze_menu_camera_rot_x.. zeroed, light dir (0,1000,1000) and white color.

functions.name: kaze_ending_debug_viewer_update
functions.purpose: Ending state-0 debug viewer: pad-2 new presses (kaze_pad2_edge_mask) toggle flags/start the credits (kaze_ending_screen_state^=1) and step credit pages (uploading via kaze_tim_load_to_vram); runs free camera kaze_ending_debug_camera_control, fade, credit prims, and model draw kaze_title_model_sort_dispatch.

functions.name: kaze_enter_critical_section
functions.purpose: PsyQ EnterCriticalSection wrapper (syscall 0 shim, A36.OBJ).

functions.name: kaze_exit_critical_section
functions.purpose: PsyQ ExitCriticalSection wrapper (syscall 0 shim, A37.OBJ).

functions.name: kaze_init_card
functions.purpose: PsyQ InitCARD: ChangeClearPAD(0), InitCARD2 with the given share flag, applies _patch_card/_patch_card2 inside a critical section.

functions.name: kaze_start_card
functions.purpose: PsyQ StartCARD: StartCARD2 plus ChangeClearPAD(0) inside a critical section.

functions.name: kaze_gs_clear_vcount
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsClearVcount/GsGetVcount helper: resets the vsync root counter via ResetRCnt(0xf2000001).

functions.name: kaze_gs_def_disp_buff
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsDefDispBuff: stores the double-buffer display/draw origins into kaze_gs_draw_buff_clip_x0.. and kaze_gs_disp_buff_x0/0eaa/0f44/0f46 (zeroed in interlace mode kaze_gs_interlace_flag), then GsSetDrawBuffClip/GsSetDrawBuffOffset.

functions.name: kaze_gs_set_projection
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsSetProjection: forwards the projection distance to SetGeomScreen (kaze_set_geom_screen).

functions.name: kaze_gs_set_work_base
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsSetWorkBase: stores the current GPU packet work area pointer in kaze_gs_work_base_ptr; called each frame by screen loops with the active packet buffer.

functions.name: kaze_init_geom
functions.purpose: PsyQ InitGeom: patches the GTE, enables COP2 in the status register, and loads default GTE registers (ZSF3/ZSF4, H=1000, DQA/DQB, OFX/OFY=0).

functions.name: kaze_trans_matrix
functions.purpose: PsyQ TransMatrix (MTX_07.OBJ): copies a 3-word translation vector into MATRIX +0x14/+0x18/+0x1c.

functions.name: kaze_set_geom_offset
functions.purpose: PsyQ SetGeomOffset (REG12.OBJ): loads the GTE screen-offset registers OFX/OFY (values <<16).

functions.name: kaze_set_geom_screen
functions.purpose: PsyQ SetGeomScreen (REG13.OBJ): loads the GTE projection-distance register H.

functions.name: kaze_read_sz_fifo3
functions.purpose: PsyQ ReadSZfifo3 (REG04.OBJ): stores the three GTE screen-Z FIFO values via gte_stsz3.

functions.name: kaze_gs_tmd_div_f3l
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsTMDdivF3L (DVF3_00.OBJ): active-subdivision renderer for flat-shaded TMD triangles, splitting polygons through the GTE and emitting divided packets into the work area.

functions.name: kaze_gs_tmd_div_g3l
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsTMDdivG3L (DVG3_00.OBJ): active-subdivision renderer for gouraud-shaded TMD triangles, emitting divided packets into the work area.

functions.name: kaze_gs_tmd_div_tg3l
functions.purpose: PsyQ GsTMDdivTG3L (DVGT3_00.OBJ): active-subdivision renderer for textured gouraud TMD triangles (tpage word 0x34808080 default), emitting divided packets.

functions.name: kaze_read_sz_fifo4
functions.purpose: PsyQ ReadSZfifo4 (REG05.OBJ): stores the four GTE screen-Z FIFO values via gte_stsz4.

functions.name: kaze_st_unset_ring
functions.purpose: PsyQ StUnSetRing (C_003.OBJ): clears the CD data/ready callbacks and CDROM registers inside a critical section, ending ring-buffer streaming.

functions.name: kaze_st_set_mask
functions.purpose: PsyQ StSetMask (C_010.OBJ): stores the stream mask/start/rewind parameters into kaze_cd_stream_mask, kaze_cd_stream_start and kaze_cd_stream_rewind.

functions.name: kaze_bios_a0_thunk
functions.purpose: BIOS call thunk: jumps through the kernel A0 function-table gateway at 0xa0.

functions.name: kaze_set_video_mode
functions.purpose: PsyQ SetVideoMode (VMODE.OBJ): swaps the NTSC/PAL mode flag kaze_video_mode and returns the previous value.

functions.name: kaze_get_video_mode
functions.purpose: PsyQ GetVideoMode (VMODE.OBJ): returns the current NTSC/PAL mode flag kaze_video_mode.

functions.name: kaze_ss_init
functions.purpose: PsyQ SsInit (SSINIT_C.OBJ): ResetCallback, SPU init via kaze_spu_init, then _SsInit for the sound system.

functions.name: kaze_ss_ut_reverb_off
functions.purpose: PsyQ SsUtReverbOff (UT_ROFF.OBJ): disables SPU reverb via SpuSetReverb(0).

functions.name: kaze_ss_ut_reverb_on
functions.purpose: PsyQ SsUtReverbOn (UT_RON.OBJ): enables SPU reverb via SpuSetReverb(1).

functions.name: kaze_ss_vm_damper_off
functions.purpose: PsyQ _SsVmDamperOff (VM_DOFF.OBJ): clears the voice-manager damper flag kaze_ss_vm_damper_flag.

functions.name: kaze_ss_vm_damper_on
functions.purpose: PsyQ _SsVmDamperOn (VM_DON.OBJ): sets the voice-manager damper flag kaze_ss_vm_damper_flag to 2.

functions.name: kaze_ss_set_mono
functions.purpose: PsyQ SsSetMono (VS_MONO.OBJ): sets the mono output flag kaze_ss_mono_flag to 1.

functions.name: kaze_ss_set_stereo
functions.purpose: PsyQ SsSetStereo (VS_MONO.OBJ): clears the mono output flag kaze_ss_mono_flag.

functions.name: kaze_spu_init
functions.purpose: PsyQ SpuInit (S_I.OBJ): initializes the SPU via _SpuInit(0).

functions.name: kaze_spu_set_in_transfer
functions.purpose: PsyQ _spu_setInTransfer (S_IT.OBJ): sets the SPU transfer-busy flag kaze_spu_transfer_busy_flag from the given flag value.

functions.name: kaze_spu_get_in_transfer
functions.purpose: PsyQ _spu_getInTransfer (S_IT.OBJ): returns whether the SPU transfer-busy flag kaze_spu_transfer_busy_flag indicates a transfer in progress.
